                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"-- 来源信息表\\n-- 用于存储通过 SourceSidebar 添加的信息（包括文本来源和外部来源）\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS source_information (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    source_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COMMENT '来源唯一标识（前端生成的ID）',\\n    title TEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '来源标题',\\n    type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('knowledge_base', 'external')) COMMENT '来源类型：knowledge_base=知识库，external=外部来源',\\n    url TEXT COMMENT '外部来源URL（仅external类型）',\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '来源描述/内容',\\n    page_type TEXT COMMENT '页面类型：tech-package, press-release, tech-strategy, tech-article',\\n    conversation_id TEXT COMMENT '关联的对话ID',\\n    metadata TEXT COMMENT '元数据（JSON格式）',\\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')) COMMENT '状态',\\n    created_by TEXT COMMENT '创建人',\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\n);\\n\\n-- 创建索引\\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_source_id ON source_information(source_id);\\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_type ON source_information(type);\\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_page_type ON source_information(page_type);\\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_conversation_id ON source_information(conversation_id);\\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_status ON source_information(status);\\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_created_at ON source_information(created_at);\","

                  "lineNumber": 34379,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import api from \\\"./api\\\";\\n\\nexport interface Source {\\n  id: string;\\n  title: string;\\n  type: \\\"knowledge_base\\\" | \\\"external\\\";\\n  url?: string;\\n  description?: string;\\n}\\n\\nexport interface SourceInformation {\\n  id?: number;\\n  source_id: string;\\n  title: string;\\n  type: \\\"knowledge_base\\\" | \\\"external\\\";\\n  url?: string;\\n  description?: string;\\n  page_type?: \\\"tech-package\\\" | \\\"press-release\\\" | \\\"tech-strategy\\\" | \\\"tech-article\\\";\\n  conversation_id?: string;\\n  metadata?: Record&amp;lt;string, any&amp;gt;;\\n  status?: \\\"active\\\" | \\\"archived\\\" | \\\"deleted\\\";\\n  created_by?: string;\\n}\\n\\nexport interface AddExternalSourceParams {\\n  title: string;\\n  url?: string;\\n  file?: File;\\n  description?: string;\\n}\\n\\nexport interface KnowledgeBaseItem {\\n  id: number;\\n  title: string;\\n  techPoint?: string;\\n  description?: string;\\n}\\n\\nconst sourceService = {\\n  /**\\n   * 获取知识库列表\\n   */\\n  async getKnowledgeBaseList(): Promise&amp;lt;{\\n    success: boolean;\\n    data?: KnowledgeBaseItem[];\\n    error?: string;\\n  }&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // 这里可以调用实际的API\\n      // const formData = new FormData();\\n      // if (params.file) {\\n      //   formData.append('file', params.file);\\n      // }\\n      // if (params.url) {\\n      //   formData.append('url', params.url);\\n      // }\\n      // formData.append('title', params.title);\\n      // if (params.description) {\\n      //   formData.append('description', params.description);\\n      // }\\n      // const response = await api.post('/sources/external', formData);\\n      // return response.data;\\n\\n      // 临时实现：直接返回本地创建的对象\\n      const source: Source = {\\n        id: &amp;#96;external_${Date.now()}&amp;#96;,\\n        title: params.title,\\n        type: \\\"external\\\",\\n        url: params.url,\\n        description: params.description,\\n      };\\n      return {\\n        success: true,\\n        data: source,\\n      };\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error(\\\"添加外部来源失败:\\\", error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: \\\"添加外部来源失败\\\",\\n      };\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 删除来源\\n   */\\n  async deleteSource(sourceId: string): Promise&amp;lt;{\\n    success: boolean;\\n    error?: string;\\n  }&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // 这里可以调用实际的API\\n      // const response = await api.delete(&amp;#96;/sources/${sourceId}&amp;#96;);\\n      // return response.data;\\n      return {\\n        success: true,\\n      };\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error(\\\"删除来源失败:\\\", error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: \\\"删除来源失败\\\",\\n      };\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 更新来源信息\\n   */\\n  async updateSource(\\n    sourceId: string,\\n    updates: Partial&amp;lt;Source&amp;gt;\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;{\\n    success: boolean;\\n    data?: Source;\\n    error?: string;\\n  }&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // 这里可以调用实际的API\\n      // const response = await api.put(&amp;#96;/sources/${sourceId}&amp;#96;, updates);\\n      // return response.data;\\n      return {\\n        success: true,\\n        data: updates as Source,\\n      };\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error(\\\"更新来源失败:\\\", error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: \\\"更新来源失败\\\",\\n      };\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 保存来源信息到数据库\\n   */\\n  async saveSourceInformation(\\n    source: Source,\\n    pageType?: string,\\n    conversationId?: string\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;{\\n    success: boolean;\\n    data?: SourceInformation;\\n    error?: string;\\n  }&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const sourceInfo: Partial&amp;lt;SourceInformation&amp;gt; = {\\n        source_id: source.id,\\n        title: source.title,\\n        type: source.type,\\n        url: source.url,\\n        description: source.description,\\n        page_type: pageType as any,\\n        conversation_id: conversationId,\\n        status: \\\"active\\\",\\n      };\\n\\n      const response = await api.post(\\\"/source-information\\\", sourceInfo);\\n      return {\\n        success: response.data.success,\\n        data: response.data.data,\\n        error: response.data.error,\\n      };\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error(\\\"保存来源信息失败:\\\", error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: \\\"保存来源信息失败\\\",\\n      };\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 批量保存来源信息到数据库\\n   */\\n  async saveSourceInformationBatch(\\n    sources: Source[],\\n    pageType?: string,\\n    conversationId?: string\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;{\\n    success: boolean;\\n    data?: SourceInformation[];\\n    error?: string;\\n  }&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const sourceInfoList: Partial&amp;lt;SourceInformation&amp;gt;[] = sources.map((source) =&amp;gt; ({\\n        source_id: source.id,\\n        title: source.title,\\n        type: source.type,\\n        url: source.url,\\n        description: source.description,\\n        page_type: pageType as any,\\n        conversation_id: conversationId,\\n        status: \\\"active\\\",\\n      }));\\n\\n      console.log('[SourceService] 批量保存来源信息:', {\\n        count: sourceInfoList.length,\\n        pageType,\\n        conversationId,\\n        sources: sourceInfoList.map(s =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.get(&amp;#96;/source-information/conversation/${conversationId}&amp;#96;);\\n      if (response.data.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.data.data) {\\n        // 将数据库格式转换为前端Source格式\\n        const sources: Source[] = response.data.data.map((item: SourceInformation) =&amp;gt; ({\\n          id: item.source_id,\\n          title: item.title,\\n          type: item.type,\\n          url: item.url,\\n          description: item.description,\\n        }));\\n        return {\\n          success: true,\\n          data: sources,\\n        };\\n      }\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: response.data.error || \\\"加载来源信息失败\\\",\\n      };\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error(\\\"加载来源信息失败:\\\", error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: \\\"加载来源信息失败\\\",\\n      };\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 根据页面类型加载来源信息\\n   */\\n  async loadSourceInformationByPageType(\\n    pageType: string\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;{\\n    success: boolean;\\n    data?: Source[];\\n    error?: string;\\n  }&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      console.log('[SourceService] 加载页面类型来源信息:', pageType);\\n      const response = await api.get(&amp;#96;/source-information/page-type/${pageType}&amp;#96;);\\n      console.log('[SourceService] 加载响应:', {\\n        success: response.data.success,\\n        dataCount: response.data.data?.length || 0,\\n        error: response.data.error,\\n        rawData: response.data\\n      });\\n      \\n      if (response.data.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.data.data) {\\n        // 将数据库格式转换为前端Source格式\\n        const sources: Source[] = response.data.data.map((item: SourceInformation) =&amp;gt; ({\\n          id: item.source_id,\\n          title: item.title,\\n          type: item.type,\\n          url: item.url,\\n          description: item.description,\\n        }));\\n        console.log('[SourceService] 转换后的来源:', sources.map(s =&amp;gt; ({ id: s.id, title: s.title })));\\n        return {\\n          success: true,\\n          data: sources,\\n        };\\n      }\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: response.data.error || \\\"加载来源信息失败\\\",\\n      };\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\n      console.error(\\\"[SourceService] 加载来源信息失败:\\\", error);\\n      console.error(\\\"[SourceService] 错误详情:\\\", {\\n        message: error.message,\\n        response: error.response?.data,\\n        status: error.response?.status\\n      });\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: error.response?.data?.error || error.message || \\\"加载来源信息失败\\\",\\n      };\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 删除来源信息（从数据库）\\n   */\\n  async deleteSourceInformation(sourceId: string): Promise&amp;lt;{\\n    success: boolean;\\n    error?: string;\\n  }&amp;gt; = ({\\n  sources = [],\\n  selectedSources = [],\\n  onSourcesChange,\\n  onSelectionChange,\\n  pageType,\\n}) =&amp;gt; {\\n  const [showAddModal, setShowAddModal] = useState(false);\\n  const [showTextModal, setShowTextModal] = useState(false);\\n  const [showKnowledgeBrowser, setShowKnowledgeBrowser] = useState(false);\\n  const [editingSource, setEditingSource] = useState&amp;lt;Source | null&amp;gt;(null);\\n  const [isSelectAll, setIsSelectAll] = useState(false);\\n\\n  const handleAddSource = () =&amp;gt; {\\n    setShowTextModal(true);\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleExplore = () =&amp;gt; {\\n    setShowKnowledgeBrowser(true);\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleSelectAll = () =&amp;gt; {\\n    const newSelectAll = !isSelectAll;\\n    setIsSelectAll(newSelectAll);\\n    if (onSelectionChange) {\\n      if (newSelectAll) {\\n        onSelectionChange(sources.map((s) =&amp;gt; s.id));\\n      } else {\\n        onSelectionChange([]);\\n      }\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleSourceToggle = (sourceId: string) =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (onSelectionChange) {\\n      const newSelection = selectedSources.includes(sourceId)\\n        ? selectedSources.filter((id) =&amp;gt; id !== sourceId)\\n        : [...selectedSources, sourceId];\\n      onSelectionChange(newSelection);\\n      setIsSelectAll(newSelection.length === sources.length &amp;amp;&amp;amp; sources.length &amp;gt; {\\n    e.stopPropagation(); // 阻止事件冒泡，防止触发编辑弹窗\\n    if (onSourcesChange) {\\n      const newSources = sources.filter((s) =&amp;gt; s.id !== sourceId);\\n      onSourcesChange(newSources);\\n      if (onSelectionChange) {\\n        onSelectionChange(\\n          selectedSources.filter((id) =&amp;gt; {\\n    const source: Source = {\\n      ...newSource,\\n      id: &amp;#96;text_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}&amp;#96;, // 确保ID唯一\\n    };\\n    if (onSourcesChange) {\\n      onSourcesChange([...sources, source]);\\n    }\\n    // 默认选中新添加的来源\\n    if (onSelectionChange) {\\n      onSelectionChange([...selectedSources, source.id]);\\n    }\\n    setShowTextModal(false);\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleSelectFromKnowledgeBase = (selectedItems: any[]) =&amp;gt;                   "content": "        \"contents\": \"import { useParams, useNavigate } from \\\"react-router-dom\\\";\\nimport PressReleasePage from \\\"./PressReleasePage\\\";\\nimport TechPackagePage from \\\"./TechPackagePage\\\";\\nimport PageTransition from \\\"../components/PageTransition\\\";\\nimport TopNavigation from \\\"../components/TopNavigation\\\";\\nimport publicPageConfigService from \\\"../services/publicPageConfigService\\\";\\nimport { PublicPageConfigPreview } from \\\"../types/publicPageConfig\\\";\\nimport { AIRoleConfig } from \\\"../types/aiRole\\\";\\n\\n// 保留的路由路径，不应该被当作地址配置处理\\nconst RESERVED_ROUTES = [\\n  'workflow', 'config', 'tech-points', 'car-series', 'ai-search-test',\\n  'ai-chat', 'workflow-stats', 'enhanced-workflow-stats', 'history',\\n  'ai-roles', 'ai-chat-multi', 'agent-workflow', 'public-page-configs',\\n  'ai-management', 'public-chat',\\n  // 标准独立页面路由\\n  'tech-package', 'tech-strategy', 'tech-article', 'press-release',\\n  // 向后兼容的路由（已重定向）\\n  'ai-search', 'tech-publish',\\n  // 管理页面路由\\n  'template-management', 'field-mapping-management'\\n];\\n\\n/**\\n * 根据地址（address）加载公开页面配置并渲染对应模版的页面\\n * 路由：/ai-search, /tech-package 等\\n */\","

                {
                  "lineNumber": 2303,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"const RESERVED_ROUTES = [\\n 'field-mapping-management'\\n];\\n\\n/**\\n * 根据地址（address）加载公开页面配置并渲染对应模版的页面\\n * 路由：/ai-search, /tech-package 等\\n */\\nconst AddressPage: React.FC = () =&amp;gt; {\\n  const { address } = useParams&amp;lt;{ address: string }&amp;gt;();\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\\n  const [executionResult, setExecutionResult] = useState&amp;lt;any&amp;gt;(null);\\n  const [publicConfig, setPublicConfig] = useState&amp;lt;PublicPageConfigPreview | null&amp;gt;(null);\\n  const [configLoading, setConfigLoading] = useState(true);\\n  const [error, setError] = useState&amp;lt;string | null&amp;gt;(null);\\n\\n  // 加载公开页面配置\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    const loadPublicConfig = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (!address) {\\n        setError('地址参数缺失');\\n        setConfigLoading(false);\\n        return;\\n      }\\n\\n      // 检查是否是保留路由\\n      if (RESERVED_ROUTES.includes(address)) {\\n        setError('该路径为系统保留路径');\\n        setConfigLoading(false);\\n        return;\\n      }\\n\\n      try {\\n        setConfigLoading(true);\\n        setError(null);\\n        // 根据地址查找配置\\n        const configData = await publicPageConfigService.getPublicConfigByAddress(address);\\n        if (configData &amp;amp;&amp;amp; configData.config) {\\n          setPublicConfig(configData);\\n        } else {\\n          setError('未找到对应的页面配置');\\n        }\\n      } catch (err: any) {\\n        console.error('加载配置失败:', err);\\n        // 如果404，说明不是有效的地址配置，跳转到首页\\n        if (err.response?.status === 404) {\\n          navigate('/');\\n          return;\\n        }\\n        setError(err.message || '加载配置失败');\\n      } finally {\\n        setConfigLoading(false);\\n      }\\n    };\\n\\n    loadPublicConfig();\\n  }, [address, navigate]);\\n\\n  // 处理节点执行\\n  const handleNodeExecution = async (inputData: any)\\n;\\n;\","

{\\n    setShowTextModal(true);\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleExplore = () =&amp;gt; {\\n    setShowKnowledgeBrowser(true);\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleSelectAll = () =&amp;gt; {\\n    const newSelectAll = !isSelectAll;\\n    setIsSelectAll(newSelectAll);\\n    if (onSelectionChange) {\\n      if (newSelectAll) {\\n        onSelectionChange(sources.map((s) =&amp;gt; s.id));\\n      } else {\\n        onSelectionChange([]);\\n      }\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleSourceToggle = (sourceId: string) =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (onSelectionChange) {\\n      const newSelection = selectedSources.includes(sourceId)\\n        ? selectedSources.filter((id) =&amp;gt; id !== sourceId)\\n        : [...selectedSources, sourceId];\\n      onSelectionChange(newSelection);\\n      setIsSelectAll(newSelection.length === sources.length &amp;amp;&amp;amp; sources.length &amp;gt; 0);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleSourceClick = (source: Source) =&amp;gt; {\\n    setEditingSource(source);\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleUpdateSource = (updatedSource: Source) =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (onSourcesChange) {\\n      const newSources = sources.map((s) =&amp;gt;\\n        s.id === updatedSource.id ? updatedSource : s\\n      );\\n      onSourcesChange(newSources);\\n    }\\n    setEditingSource(null);\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleDeleteSource = (sourceId: string, e: React.MouseEvent) =&amp;gt; {\\n    e.stopPropagation(); // 阻止事件冒泡，防止触发编辑弹窗\\n    if (onSourcesChange) {\\n      const newSources = sources.filter((s) =&amp;gt; s.id !== sourceId);\\n      onSourcesChange(newSources);\\n      if (onSelectionChange) {\\n        onSelectionChange(\\n          selectedSources.filter((id) =&amp;gt; id !== sourceId)\\n        );\\n      }\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleAddExternalSource = (newSource: Omit&amp;lt;Source, \\\"id\\\"&amp;gt;) =&amp;gt; {\\n    const source: Source = {\\n      ...newSource,\\n      id: &amp;#96;external_${Date.now()}&amp;#96;,\\n    };\\n    if (onSourcesChange) {\\n      onSourcesChange([...sources, source]);\\n    }\\n    setShowAddModal(false);\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleAddTextSource = (newSource: Omit&amp;lt;Source, \\\"id\\\"&amp;gt;) =&amp;gt; (\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"p-4 text-center text-gray-500 text-sm\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            暂无来源，点击\\\"添加信息\\\"添加来源\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n        ) : (\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"p-2\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {sources.map((source) =&amp;gt; (\\n              &amp;lt;div\\n                key={source.id}\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; handleSourceClick(source)}\\n                className=\\\"flex items-start gap-3 p-3 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors group cursor-pointer\\\"\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;input\\n                  type=\\\"checkbox\\\"\\n                  checked={selectedSources.includes(source.id)}\\n                  onChange={() =&amp;gt;                 {
                  "lineNumber": 20858,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"/**\\n * AI问答页面\\n * 复用tech-package系统构建，但作为独立页面可进行定制化改造\\n */\\nimport React from \\\"react\\\";\\nimport BaseAISearchPage from \\\"../components/ai-search/BaseAISearchPage\\\";\\nimport { aiQaConfig } from \\\"../configs/pageConfigs\\\";\\n\\nconst AIQAPage: React.FC = () =&amp;gt; {\\n  return &amp;lt;BaseAISearchPage config={aiQaConfig} /&amp;gt;;\\n};\\n\\nexport default AIQAPage;\\n\\n\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 20962,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import api from './api';\\nimport { agentWorkflowService } from './agentWorkflowService';\\nimport { techPointService } from './techPointService';\\nimport { knowledgePointService } from './knowledgePointService';\\nimport {\\n  Conversation,\\n  Message,\\n  OutputContent,\\n  WorkflowConfig,\\n  FileUploadResponse,\\n  CreateConversationRequest,\\n  SendMessageRequest,\\n  ApiResponse,\\n  Source,\\n  FieldMappingConfig,\\n} from '../types/aiSearch';\\n\\n/**\\n * AI问答服务\\n */\\nclass AiSearchService {\\n  private normalizeMessage(raw: any): Message {\\n    return {\\n      ...raw,\\n      createdAt: raw?.createdAt ? new Date(raw.createdAt) : new Date(),\\n    };\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取配置的工作流\\n   */\\n  async getWorkflowConfig(pageType?: 'tech-package' | 'press-release' | 'tech-strategy' | 'tech-article'): Promise&amp;lt;WorkflowConfig | null&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // 先尝试从API获取配置的工作流ID，传递pageType参数\\n      const params = pageType ? &amp;#96;?pageType=${pageType}&amp;#96; : '';\\n      const response = await api.get(&amp;#96;/ai-search/workflow${params}&amp;#96;);\\n      if (response.data.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.data.data) {\\n        const workflowId = response.data.data.workflowId;\\n        // 获取工作流详情\\n        const workflows = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\\n        const workflow = workflows.find((w) =&amp;gt; w.id === workflowId);\\n        if (workflow) {\\n          return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(workflow);\\n        }\\n      }\\n      \\n      // 如果没有配置，尝试查找默认工作流（根据页面类型）\\n      const workflows = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\\n      const defaultWorkflowName = pageType === 'press-release' ? '发布会稿工作流' : '智能工作流';\\n      const defaultWorkflow = workflows.find((w) =&amp;gt; w.name === defaultWorkflowName);\\n      if (defaultWorkflow) {\\n        return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(defaultWorkflow);\\n      }\\n      \\n      // 返回第一个工作流\\n      if (workflows.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n        return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(workflows[0]);\\n      }\\n      \\n      return null;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('获取工作流配置失败:', error);\\n      return null;\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 转换工作流为配置格式\\n   */\\n  private convertWorkflowToConfig(workflow: any): WorkflowConfig {\\n    // 从工作流的输入节点和输出节点提取参数\\n    const inputNode = workflow.nodes.find((n: any) =&amp;gt; n.type === 'input');\\n    const outputNode = workflow.nodes.find((n: any) =&amp;gt; n.type === 'output');\\n    \\n    const inputParameters = inputNode?.data?.inputs || [];\\n    const outputParameters = outputNode?.data?.outputs || [];\\n    \\n    return {\\n      id: workflow.id,\\n      name: workflow.name,\\n      description: workflow.description,\\n      inputParameters: inputParameters.map((p: any) =&amp;gt; ({\\n        name: p.name,\\n        type: p.type || 'string',\\n        required: p.required || false,\\n        description: p.description,\\n      })),\\n      outputParameters: outputParameters.map((p: any) =&amp;gt; ({\\n        name: p.name,\\n        type: p.type || 'object',\\n        description: p.description,\\n      })),\\n    };\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取文件列表\\n   */\\n  async getFiles(options?: {\\n    category?: string;\","

                  "lineNumber": 5445,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"class AiSearchService {\\n\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 上传文件\\n   */\\n  async uploadFiles(files: File[], pageType?: 'tech-package' | 'press-release' | 'tech-strategy' | 'tech-article'): Promise&amp;lt;FileUploadResponse[]&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const formData = new FormData();\\n      files.forEach((file) =&amp;gt; {\\n        formData.append('files', file);\\n      });\\n      \\n      // 如果提供了pageType，添加到formData\\n      if (pageType) {\\n        formData.append('pageType', pageType);\\n      }\\n\\n      const response = await api.post('/ai-search/upload', formData, {\\n        headers: {\\n          'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data',\\n        },\\n      });\\n\\n      if (response.data.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.data.data) {\\n        return response.data.data;\\n      }\\n      throw new Error(response.data.error || '文件上传失败');\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('文件上传失败:', error);\\n      throw error;\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 合并知识库内容\\n   */\\n  async mergeKnowledgeBaseContent(sources: Source[]): Promise&amp;lt;string&amp;gt; {\\n    const knowledgeBaseSources = sources.filter((s) =&amp;gt; s.type === 'knowledge_base');\\n  }\","

                  "lineNumber": 8922,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"-- 来源信息表\\n-- 用于存储通过 SourceSidebar 添加的信息（包括文本来源和外部来源）\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS source_information (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    source_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COMMENT '来源唯一标识（前端生成的ID）',\\n    title TEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '来源标题',\\n    type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('knowledge_base', 'external')) COMMENT '来源类型：knowledge_base=知识库，external=外部来源',\\n    url TEXT COMMENT '外部来源URL（仅external类型）',\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '来源描述/内容',\\n    page_type TEXT COMMENT '页面类型：tech-package, press-release, tech-strategy, tech-article',\\n    conversation_id TEXT COMMENT '关联的对话ID',\\n    metadata TEXT COMMENT '元数据（JSON格式）',\\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')) COMMENT '状态',\\n    created_by TEXT COMMENT '创建人',\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\n);\\n\\n-- 创建索引\\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_source_id ON source_information(source_id);\\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_type ON source_information(type);\\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_page_type ON source_information(page_type);\\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_conversation_id ON source_information(conversation_id);\\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_status ON source_information(status);\\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_created_at ON source_information(created_at);\","
                },

                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import api from './api';\\nimport { agentWorkflowService } from './agentWorkflowService';\\nimport { techPointService } from './techPointService';\\nimport { knowledgePointService } from './knowledgePointService';\\nimport {\\n  Conversation,\\n  Message,\\n  OutputContent,\\n  WorkflowConfig,\\n  FileUploadResponse,\\n  CreateConversationRequest,\\n  SendMessageRequest,\\n  ApiResponse,\\n  Source,\\n  FieldMappingConfig,\\n} from '../types/aiSearch';\\n\\n/**\\n * AI问答服务\\n */\\nclass AiSearchService {\\n  private normalizeMessage(raw: any): Message {\\n    return {\\n      ...raw,\\n      createdAt: raw?.createdAt ? new Date(raw.createdAt) : new Date(),\\n    };\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取配置的工作流\\n   */\\n  async getWorkflowConfig(pageType?: 'tech-package' | 'press-release' | 'tech-strategy' | 'tech-article'): Promise&amp;lt;WorkflowConfig | null&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // 先尝试从API获取配置的工作流ID，传递pageType参数\\n      const params = pageType ? &amp;#96;?pageType=${pageType}&amp;#96; : '';\\n      const response = await api.get(&amp;#96;/ai-search/workflow${params}&amp;#96;);\\n      if (response.data.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.data.data) {\\n        const workflowId = response.data.data.workflowId;\\n        // 获取工作流详情\\n        const workflows = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\\n        const workflow = workflows.find((w) =&amp;gt; w.id === workflowId);\\n        if (workflow) {\\n          return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(workflow);\\n        }\\n      }\\n      \\n      // 如果没有配置，尝试查找默认工作流（根据页面类型）\\n      const workflows = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\\n      const defaultWorkflowName = pageType === 'press-release' ? '发布会稿工作流' : '智能工作流';\\n      const defaultWorkflow = workflows.find((w) =&amp;gt; w.name === defaultWorkflowName);\\n      if (defaultWorkflow) {\\n        return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(defaultWorkflow);\\n      }\\n      \\n      // 返回第一个工作流\\n      if (workflows.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n        return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(workflows[0]);\\n      }\\n      \\n      return null;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('获取工作流配置失败:', error);\\n      return null;\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 转换工作流为配置格式\\n   */\\n  private convertWorkflowToConfig(workflow: any): WorkflowConfig {\\n    // 从工作流的输入节点和输出节点提取参数\\n    const inputNode = workflow.nodes.find((n: any) =&amp;gt; n.type === 'input');\\n    const outputNode = workflow.nodes.find((n: any) =&amp;gt; n.type === 'output');\\n    \\n    const inputParameters = inputNode?.data?.inputs || [];\\n    const outputParameters = outputNode?.data?.outputs || [];\\n    \\n    return {\\n      id: workflow.id,\\n      name: workflow.name,\\n      description: workflow.description,\\n      inputParameters: inputParameters.map((p: any) =&amp;gt; ({\\n        name: p.name,\\n        type: p.type || 'string',\\n        required: p.required || false,\\n        description: p.description,\\n      })),\\n      outputParameters: outputParameters.map((p: any) =&amp;gt; ({\\n        name: p.name,\\n        type: p.type || 'object',\\n        description: p.description,\\n      })),\\n    };\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取文件列表\\n   */\\n  async getFiles(options?: {\\n    category?: string;\","

                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import React, { useState } from \\\"react\\\";\\nimport { X, Upload, Link as LinkIcon, Trash2 } from \\\"lucide-react\\\";\\nimport { Source } from \\\"./SourceSidebar\\\";\\nimport { aiSearchService } from \\\"../../services/aiSearchService\\\";\\n\\ninterface AddSourceModalProps {\\n  onClose: () =&amp;gt; void;\\n  onAddExternalSource: (source: Omit&amp;lt;Source, \\\"id\\\"&amp;gt;) =&amp;gt; void;\\n  pageType?: 'tech-package' | 'press-release' | 'tech-strategy' | 'tech-article';\\n}\\n\\nconst AddSourceModal: React.FC&amp;lt;AddSourceModalProps&amp;gt; = ({\\n  onClose,\\n  onAddExternalSource,\\n  pageType,\\n}) =&amp;gt; {\\n  const [sourceType, setSourceType] = useState&amp;lt;\\\"url\\\" | \\\"file\\\"&amp;gt;(\\\"url\\\");\\n  const [url, setUrl] = useState(\\\"\\\");\\n  const [title, setTitle] = useState(\\\"\\\");\\n  const [description, setDescription] = useState(\\\"\\\");\\n  const [files, setFiles] = useState&amp;lt;File[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [isUploading, setIsUploading] = useState(false);\\n\\n  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&amp;gt; {\\n    e.preventDefault();\\n    if (sourceType === \\\"url\\\") {\\n      if (!url.trim()) {\\n        alert(\\\"请输入URL\\\");\\n        return;\\n      }\\n      onAddExternalSource({\\n        title: title.trim() || url,\\n        type: \\\"external\\\",\\n        url: url.trim(),\\n        description: description.trim(),\\n      });\\n      setUrl(\\\"\\\");\\n      setTitle(\\\"\\\");\\n      setDescription(\\\"\\\");\\n      onClose();\\n    } else {\\n      if (files.length === 0) {\\n        alert(\\\"请选择文件\\\");\\n        return;\\n      }\\n      \\n      // 上传文件到服务器\\n      setIsUploading(true);\\n      try {\\n        const uploadedFiles = await aiSearchService.uploadFiles(files, pageType);\\n        \\n        // 文件已保存到数据库，不需要通过onAddExternalSource添加\\n        // 页面会自动通过loadFiles加载文件列表\\n        // 只需要关闭弹窗即可\\n        \\n        setFiles([]);\\n        setTitle(\\\"\\\");\\n        setDescription(\\\"\\\");\\n        onClose();\\n        \\n        // 触发文件列表刷新（通过自定义事件）\\n        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('filesUploaded'));\\n      } catch (error) {\\n        console.error('文件上传失败:', error);\\n        alert('文件上传失败，请重试');\\n      } finally {\\n        setIsUploading(false);\\n      }\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleFileChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent&amp;lt;HTMLInputElement&amp;gt;) =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (e.target.files) {\\n      const newFiles = Array.from(e.target.files);\\n      setFiles([...files, ...newFiles]);\\n      if (!title.trim() &amp;amp;&amp;amp; newFiles.length === 1) {\\n        setTitle(newFiles[0].name);\\n      }\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleRemoveFile = (index: number) =&amp;gt; {\\n    setFiles(files.filter((_, i) =&amp;gt; i !== index));\\n  };\\n\\n  const formatFileSize = (bytes: number): string =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (bytes &amp;lt; 1024) return bytes + \\\" B\\\";\\n    if (bytes &amp;lt; {\\n                setSourceType(\\\"file\\\");\\n                setUrl(\\\"\\\");\\n              }}\\n              className={&amp;#96;flex-1 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg transition-colors ${\\n                sourceType === \\\"file\\\"\\n                  ? \\\"bg-blue-600 text-white\\\"\\n                  : \\\"bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-200\\\"\\n              }&amp;#96;}\\n            &amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;Upload className=\\\"w-4 h-4 inline-block mr-2\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n              上传文件\\n            &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* URL输入 */}\\n          {sourceType === \\\"url\\\" &amp;amp;&amp;amp;                   "lineNumber": 37322,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"/**\\n * 获取文件列表\\n * GET /api/v1/ai-search/files?pageType=tech-package|press-release\\n */\\nrouter.get('/files', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    await initializeFileTable();\\n\\n    const category = req.query.category as string | undefined;\\n    const conversationId = req.query.conversationId as string | undefined;\\n    const pageType = req.query.pageType as string | undefined; // 'tech-package' | 'press-release'\\n    const limit = req.query.limit ? parseInt(req.query.limit as string, 10) : undefined;\\n    const offset = req.query.offset ? parseInt(req.query.offset as string, 10) : undefined;\\n    const excludeGarbled = req.query.excludeGarbled !== 'false'; // 默认排除乱码文件名\\n\\n    const files = await fileService.getAllFiles({\\n      category,\\n      conversationId,\\n      pageType,\\n      limit,\\n      offset,\\n      excludeGarbled, // 默认排除乱码文件名\\n    });\\n\\n    const fileList = files.map((file) =&amp;gt; ({\\n      id: file.file_id,\\n      fileId: file.file_id,\\n      name: file.original_name,\\n      url: file.file_url,\\n      type: file.mime_type,\\n      size: file.file_size,\\n      category: file.category,\\n      tags: file.tags ? JSON.parse(file.tags) : [],\\n      description: file.description,\\n      usageCount: file.usage_count,\\n      lastUsedAt: file.last_used_at,\\n      createdAt: file.created_at,\\n      updatedAt: file.updated_at,\\n    }));\\n\\n    res.json(\\n      formatApiResponse(true, fileList, '获取文件列表成功')\\n    );\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    logger.error('获取文件列表失败:', error);\\n    res.status(500).json(\\n      formatApiResponse(\\n        false,\\n        null,\\n        '获取文件列表失败',\\n        error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\n      )\\n    );\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n/**\\n * 删除文件（软删除）\\n * DELETE /api/v1/ai-search/files/:fileId\\n */\","

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"export class FileService {\\n\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取所有文件列表\\n   */\\n  async getAllFiles(options?: {\\n    category?: string;\\n    status?: string;\\n    conversationId?: string;\\n    pageType?: string; AND category = ?&amp;#96;;\\n        params.push(options.category);\\n      }\\n\\n      if (options?.status) {\\n        sql += &amp;#96; AND status = ?&amp;#96;;\\n        params.push(options.status);\\n      } else {\\n        sql += &amp;#96; AND status = 'active'&amp;#96;;\\n      }\\n\\n      if (options?.conversationId) {\\n        sql += &amp;#96; AND conversation_id = ?&amp;#96;;\\n        params.push(options.conversationId);\\n      }\\n\\n      // 按页面类型过滤（通过metadata字段）\\n      if (options?.pageType) {\\n        // 只返回metadata中包含指定pageType的文件\\n        sql += &amp;#96; AND metadata LIKE ?&amp;#96;;\\n        params.push(&amp;#96;%\\\"pageType\\\":\\\"${options.pageType}\\\"%&amp;#96;);\\n      }\\n      // 如果没有指定pageType，返回所有文件（包括没有metadata的旧文件）\\n\\n      // 排除乱码文件名\\n      if (options?.excludeGarbled) {\\n        sql += &amp;#96; AND original_name NOT LIKE '%ã€%' AND original_name NOT LIKE '%ç¥%' AND original_name NOT LIKE '%æ%'&amp;#96;;\\n      }\\n\\n      sql += &amp;#96; ORDER BY created_at DESC&amp;#96;;\\n\\n      if (options?.limit) {\\n        sql += &amp;#96; LIMIT ?&amp;#96;;\\n        params.push(options.limit);\\n      }\\n\\n      if (options?.offset) {\\n        sql += &amp;#96; OFFSET ?&amp;#96;;\\n        params.push(options.offset);\\n      }\\n\\n      const rows = await db.query(sql, params);\\n      \\n      // 基于文件哈希去重，只保留最新的记录\\n      const fileMap = new Map&amp;lt;string, FileRecord&amp;gt;();\\n      for (const row of rows as FileRecord[]) {\\n        if (row.file_hash) {\\n          const existing = fileMap.get(row.file_hash);\\n  }\\n}\","

                {
                  "lineNumber": 11238,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"class PublicPageConfigService {\\n\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 初始化/更新默认页面配置\\n   * 确保技术包装、技术策略、技术通稿、发布会稿这4个页面使用正确的模板并处于开启状态\\n   * @param templates 模板HTML映射对象，用于获取模板HTML内容\\n   */\\n  async ensureDefaultPageConfigs(templates?: Record&amp;lt;string, string&amp;gt;): Promise&amp;lt;PublicPageConfig[]&amp;gt; {\\n    const existingConfigs = await this.getAllConfigs();\\n    const updatedConfigs: PublicPageConfig[] = [];\\n\\n    // 定义需要确保的4个页面配置\\n    const defaultPageConfigs = [\\n      {\\n        name: '技术包装',\\n        description: '技术内容包装工作流公开页面',\\n        address: 'tech-package',\\n        templateType: 'ai-chat-source-tools' as const,\\n      },\\n      {\\n        name: '技术策略',\\n        description: '技术策略生成工作流公开页面',\\n        address: 'tech-strategy',\\n        templateType: 'ai-chat-source-tools' as const,\\n      },\\n      {\\n        name: '技术通稿',\\n        description: '核心内容生成工作流公开页面',\\n        address: 'tech-article',\\n        templateType: 'ai-chat-source-tools' as const,\\n      },\\n      {\\n        name: '发布会稿',\\n        description: '技术发布内容生成工作流公开页面',\\n        address: 'press-release',\\n        templateType: 'ai-chat-source-tools' as const,\\n      },\\n    ];\\n\\n    for (const defaultConfig of defaultPageConfigs)\\n  }\\n}\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 11322,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"        address: 'tech-package',\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 12630,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import express from 'express';\\nimport { formatApiResponse, formatValidationErrorResponse } from '../utils/validation';\\nimport { publicPageConfigModel, agentWorkflowModel, aiRoleModel } from '../models';\\nimport { CreatePublicPageConfigDTO, UpdatePublicPageConfigDTO } from '../models/PublicPageConfig';\\n\\nconst router = express.Router();\\n\\n/**\\n * 获取所有公开页面配置\\n * GET /api/v1/public-page-configs\\n */\\nrouter.get('/', async (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    const configs = await publicPageConfigModel.getAll();\\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, configs, '获取配置列表成功'));\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    console.error('获取配置列表失败:', error);\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\n      false,\\n      null,\\n      '获取配置列表失败',\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\n    ));\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n/**\\n * 获取单个配置\\n * GET /api/v1/public-page-configs/:id\\n */\\nrouter.get('/:id', async (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    const { id } = req.params;\\n    const config = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\\n    \\n    if (!config) {\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\\n    }\\n    \\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, config, '获取配置成功'));\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    console.error('获取配置失败:', error);\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\n      false,\\n      null,\\n      '获取配置失败',\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\n    ));\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n/**\\n * 创建公开页面配置\\n * POST /api/v1/public-page-configs\\n */\\nrouter.post('/', async (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    const { name, description, address, displayMode, workflowId, roleIds, templateType, customHtml } = req.body;\\n    \\n    // 验证必填字段\\n    if (!name) {\\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\\n        field: 'name',\\n        message: '配置名称不能为空'\\n      }]));\\n    }\\n\\n    // 如果没有提供displayMode，使用默认值'role'\\n    const finalDisplayMode = displayMode || 'role';\\n\\n    // 验证显示模式\\n    if (finalDisplayMode &amp;amp;&amp;amp; !['all', 'workflow', 'custom', 'role'].includes(finalDisplayMode)) {\\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\\n        field: 'displayMode',\\n        message: '显示模式必须是all、workflow、custom或role之一'\\n      }]));\\n    }\\n\\n    // 验证workflow模式\\n    if (finalDisplayMode === 'workflow' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; !workflowId) {\\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\\n        field: 'workflowId',\\n        message: '工作流模式下必须提供workflowId'\\n      }]));\\n    }\\n\\n    // 验证custom模式\\n    if (finalDisplayMode === 'custom' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (!roleIds || !Array.isArray(roleIds) || roleIds.length === 0)) {\\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\\n        field: 'roleIds',\\n        message: '自定义模式下必须提供角色ID列表'\\n      }]));\\n    }\\n\\n    // 验证role模式（如果没有提供roleIds，使用空数组）\\n    // 注意：role模式允许空数组，表示显示所有角色\\n    \\n    const createData: CreatePublicPageConfigDTO = {\\n      name,\\n      description,\\n      address,\\n      displayMode: finalDisplayMode,\\n      workflowId,\\n      roleIds: roleIds || (finalDisplayMode === 'role' ? [] : undefined),\\n      templateType,\\n      customHtml,\\n      isActive: req.body.isActive, // 支持创建时设置isActive\\n    };\\n    \\n    const newConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.create(createData);\\n    \\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, newConfig, '创建配置成功'));\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    console.error('创建配置失败:', error);\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\n      false,\\n      null,\\n      '创建配置失败',\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\n    ));\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n/**\\n * 更新公开页面配置\\n * PUT /api/v1/public-page-configs/:id\\n */\\nrouter.put('/:id', async (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    const { id } = req.params;\\n    const { name, description, address, displayMode, workflowId, roleIds, isActive, templateType, customHtml } = req.body;\\n    \\n    // 检查配置是否存在\\n    const existingConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\\n    if (!existingConfig) {\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\\n    }\\n\\n    // 验证显示模式\\n    if (displayMode &amp;amp;&amp;amp; !['all', 'workflow', 'custom', 'role'].includes(displayMode)) {\\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\\n        field: 'displayMode',\\n        message: '显示模式必须是all、workflow、custom或role之一'\\n      }]));\\n    }\\n\\n    const updateData: UpdatePublicPageConfigDTO = {\\n      name,\\n      description,\\n      address,\\n      displayMode,\\n      workflowId,\\n      roleIds,\\n      isActive,\\n      templateType,\\n      customHtml,\\n    };\\n    \\n    const updatedConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.update(id, updateData);\\n    \\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, updatedConfig, '更新配置成功'));\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    console.error('更新配置失败:', error);\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\n      false,\\n      null,\\n      '更新配置失败',\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\n    ));\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n/**\\n * 删除公开页面配置\\n * DELETE /api/v1/public-page-configs/:id\\n */\\nrouter.delete('/:id', async (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    const { id } = req.params;\\n    \\n    // 检查配置是否存在\\n    const existingConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\\n    if (!existingConfig) {\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\\n    }\\n    \\n    await publicPageConfigModel.delete(id);\\n    \\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, null, '删除配置成功'));\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    console.error('删除配置失败:', error);\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\n      false,\\n      null,\\n      '删除配置失败',\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\n    ));\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n/**\\n * 预览配置（获取角色列表）\\n * GET /api/v1/public-page-configs/:id/preview\\n */\\nrouter.get('/:id/preview', async (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    const { id } = req.params;\\n    const config = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\\n    \\n    if (!config) {\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\\n    }\\n\\n    let roles: any[] = [];\\n    \\n    if (config.displayMode === 'all') {\\n      // 获取所有启用的角色\\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;gt; r.enabled);\\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'workflow' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.workflowId) {\\n      // 从工作流中提取角色\\n      const workflow = await agentWorkflowModel.getById(config.workflowId);\\n      if (workflow) {\\n        const workflowNodes = JSON.parse(workflow.nodes);\\n        const agentIds = workflowNodes.map((node: any) =&amp;gt; node.agentId).filter(Boolean);\\n        const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\n        roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;gt; agentIds.includes(r.id) &amp;amp;&amp;amp; r.enabled);\\n      }\\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'custom' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.roleIds &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.roleIds.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      // 获取指定的角色\\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;gt; config.roleIds!.includes(r.id) &amp;amp;&amp;amp; r.enabled);\\n    }\\n    \\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, { roles, config }, '获取配置预览成功'));\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    console.error('获取配置预览失败:', error);\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\n      false,\\n      null,\\n      '获取配置预览失败',\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\n    ));\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n/**\\n * 导入独立页面配置\\n * POST /api/v1/public-page-configs/import-independent-pages\\n */\\nrouter.post('/import-independent-pages', async (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    // 获取所有独立页面角色\\n    const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\n    const independentPageRoles = allRoles.filter(\\n      r =&amp;gt; r.source === 'independent-page' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; r.enabled\\n    );\\n\\n    if (independentPageRoles.length === 0) {\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(\\n        false,\\n        null,\\n        '未找到独立页面角色，请先初始化独立页面AI角色'\\n      ));\\n    }\\n\\n    // 定义节点映射\\n    const nodeMapping: Record&amp;lt;string, { name: string; description: string }&amp;gt; = {\\n      'independent-page-ai-search': {\\n        name: 'AI问答',\\n        description: '智能问答和搜索功能公开页面'\\n      },\\n      'independent-page-tech-package': {\\n        name: '技术包装',\\n        description: '技术内容包装工作流公开页面'\\n      },\\n      'independent-page-tech-strategy': {\\n        name: '技术策略',\\n        description: '技术策略生成工作流公开页面'\\n      },\\n      'independent-page-core-draft': {\\n        name: '技术通稿',\\n        description: '核心内容生成工作流公开页面'\\n      },\\n      'independent-page-speech': {\\n        name: '发布会演讲稿',\\n        description: '技术发布内容生成工作流公开页面'\\n      }\\n    };\\n\\n    const importResults: Array&amp;lt;{ role: any; config: any; status: 'created' | 'exists' | 'error'; error?: string }&amp;gt; = [];\\n\\n    // 为每个独立页面角色创建公开页面配置\\n    for (const role of independentPageRoles) {\\n      try {\\n        // 检查是否已存在配置（通过名称匹配）\\n        const existingConfigs = await publicPageConfigModel.getAll();\\n        const existing = existingConfigs.find(\\n          c =&amp;gt; c.name === (nodeMapping[role.id]?.name || role.name)\\n        );\\n\\n        if (existing) {\\n          importResults.push({\\n            role,\\n            config: existing,\\n            status: 'exists'\\n          });\\n          continue;\\n        }\\n\\n        // 创建新配置\\n        const nodeInfo = nodeMapping[role.id] || {\\n          name: role.name,\\n          description: &amp;#96;${role.description}公开页面&amp;#96;\\n        };\\n\\n        const createData: CreatePublicPageConfigDTO = {\\n          name: nodeInfo.name,\\n          description: nodeInfo.description,\\n          displayMode: 'custom',\\n          roleIds: [role.id],\\n        };\\n\\n        const newConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.create(createData);\\n        importResults.push({\\n          role,\\n          config: newConfig,\\n          status: 'created'\\n        });\\n      } catch (error) {\\n        importResults.push({\\n          role,\\n          config: null,\\n          status: 'error',\\n          error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\n        });\\n      }\\n    }\\n\\n    const createdCount = importResults.filter(r =&amp;gt; r.status === 'created').length;\\n    const existsCount = importResults.filter(r =&amp;gt; r.status === 'exists').length;\\n    const errorCount = importResults.filter(r =&amp;gt; r.status === 'error').length;\\n\\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, {\\n      results: importResults,\\n      summary: {\\n        total: independentPageRoles.length,\\n        created: createdCount,\\n        exists: existsCount,\\n        errors: errorCount\\n      }\\n    }, &amp;#96;导入完成：创建${createdCount}个，已存在${existsCount}个，失败${errorCount}个&amp;#96;));\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    console.error('导入独立页面配置失败:', error);\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\n      false,\\n      null,\\n      '导入独立页面配置失败',\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\n    ));\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n/**\\n * 根据地址获取配置\\n * GET /api/v1/public-page-configs/by-address/:address\\n */\\nrouter.get('/by-address/:address', async (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    const { address } = req.params;\\n    const config = await publicPageConfigModel.getByAddress(address);\\n    \\n    if (!config) {\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在或已禁用'));\\n    }\\n    \\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, config, '获取配置成功'));\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    console.error('获取配置失败:', error);\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\n      false,\\n      null,\\n      '获取配置失败',\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\n    ));\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n/**\\n * 切换配置启用状态\\n * PATCH /api/v1/public-page-configs/:id/toggle\\n */\\nrouter.patch('/:id/toggle', async (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    const { id } = req.params;\\n    const { isActive } = req.body;\\n\\n    // 检查配置是否存在\\n    const existingConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\\n    if (!existingConfig) {\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\\n    }\\n\\n    const updateData: UpdatePublicPageConfigDTO = {\\n      isActive: typeof isActive === 'boolean' ? isActive : !existingConfig.isActive,\\n    };\\n\\n    const updatedConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.update(id, updateData);\\n\\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, updatedConfig, '切换状态成功'));\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    console.error('切换状态失败:', error);\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\n      false,\\n      null,\\n      '切换状态失败',\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\n    ));\\n  }\\n});\\n\\nexport default router;\\n\\n\","

                  "lineNumber": 16063,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"const RESERVED_ROUTES = [\\n 'field-mapping-management'\\n];\\n\\n/**\\n * 根据地址（address）加载公开页面配置并渲染对应模版的页面\\n * 路由：/ai-search, /tech-package 等\\n */\\nconst AddressPage: React.FC = () =&amp;gt; {\\n  const { address } = useParams&amp;lt;{ address: string }&amp;gt;();\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\\n  const [executionResult, setExecutionResult] = useState&amp;lt;any&amp;gt;(null);\\n  const [publicConfig, setPublicConfig] = useState&amp;lt;PublicPageConfigPreview | null&amp;gt;(null);\\n  const [configLoading, setConfigLoading] = useState(true);\\n  const [error, setError] = useState&amp;lt;string | null&amp;gt;(null);\\n\\n  // 加载公开页面配置\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    const loadPublicConfig = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (!address) {\\n        setError('地址参数缺失');\\n        setConfigLoading(false);\\n        return;\\n      }\\n\\n      // 检查是否是保留路由\\n      if (RESERVED_ROUTES.includes(address)) {\\n        setError('该路径为系统保留路径');\\n        setConfigLoading(false);\\n        return;\\n      }\\n\\n      try {\\n        setConfigLoading(true);\\n        setError(null);\\n        // 根据地址查找配置\\n        const configData = await publicPageConfigService.getPublicConfigByAddress(address);\\n        if (configData &amp;amp;&amp;amp; configData.config) {\\n          setPublicConfig(configData);\\n        } else {\\n          setError('未找到对应的页面配置');\\n        }\\n      } catch (err: any) {\\n        console.error('加载配置失败:', err);\\n        // 如果404，说明不是有效的地址配置，跳转到首页\\n        if (err.response?.status === 404) {\\n          navigate('/');\\n          return;\\n        }\\n        setError(err.message || '加载配置失败');\\n      } finally {\\n        setConfigLoading(false);\\n      }\\n    };\\n\\n    loadPublicConfig();\\n  }, [address, navigate]);\\n\\n  // 处理节点执行\\n  const handleNodeExecution = async (inputData: any)\\n;\\n;\","

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"import { useParams, useNavigate } from \\\"react-router-dom\\\";\\nimport PressReleasePage from \\\"./PressReleasePage\\\";\\nimport TechPackagePage from \\\"./TechPackagePage\\\";\\nimport PageTransition from \\\"../components/PageTransition\\\";\\nimport TopNavigation from \\\"../components/TopNavigation\\\";\\nimport publicPageConfigService from \\\"../services/publicPageConfigService\\\";\\nimport { PublicPageConfigPreview } from \\\"../types/publicPageConfig\\\";\\nimport { AIRoleConfig } from \\\"../types/aiRole\\\";\\n\\n// 保留的路由路径，不应该被当作地址配置处理\\nconst RESERVED_ROUTES = [\\n  'workflow', 'config', 'tech-points', 'car-series', 'ai-search-test',\\n  'ai-chat', 'workflow-stats', 'enhanced-workflow-stats', 'history',\\n  'ai-roles', 'ai-chat-multi', 'agent-workflow', 'public-page-configs',\\n  'ai-management', 'public-chat',\\n  // 标准独立页面路由\\n  'tech-package', 'tech-strategy', 'tech-article', 'press-release',\\n  // 向后兼容的路由（已重定向）\\n  'ai-search', 'tech-publish',\\n  // 管理页面路由\\n  'template-management', 'field-mapping-management'\\n];\\n\\n/**\\n * 根据地址（address）加载公开页面配置并渲染对应模版的页面\\n * 路由：/ai-search, /tech-package 等\\n */\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 17021,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"  'tech-package', 'tech-strategy', 'tech-article', 'press-release',\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 17056,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \" * 路由：/ai-search, /tech-package 等\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 18360,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from \\\"react\\\";\\nimport { useNavigate, useLocation } from \\\"react-router-dom\\\";\\nimport {\\n  MessageCircle,\\n  Target,\\n  FileText,\\n  Mic,\\n  Home,\\n  Settings,\\n  User,\\n  ChevronDown,\\n} from \\\"lucide-react\\\";\\nimport publicPageConfigService from \\\"../services/publicPageConfigService\\\";\\nimport { PublicPageConfig } from \\\"../types/publicPageConfig\\\";\\n\\ninterface TopNavigationProps {\\n  currentPageTitle?: string;\\n}\\n\\ninterface NavigationItem {\\n  id: string;\\n  label: string;\\n  icon: any;\\n  path: string;\\n  disabled: boolean;\\n  category: 'main' | 'management';\\n  configId?: string;\\n}\\n\\n// 主要功能的固定顺序和映射\\nconst MAIN_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: '项目管理', icon: Home, path: '/', address: null },\\n  { name: '技术包装', icon: MessageCircle, path: '/tech-package', address: 'tech-package' },\\n  { name: '技术策略', icon: Target, path: '/tech-strategy', address: 'tech-strategy' },\\n  { name: '技术通稿', icon: FileText, path: '/tech-article', address: 'tech-article' },\\n  { name: '发布会稿', icon: Mic, path: '/press-release', address: 'press-release' },\\n];\\n\\n// 管理功能的固定顺序和映射（合并为Agent配置）\\nconst MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: 'Agent配置', icon: Settings, path: '/ai-management' },\\n];\\n\\n// Agent配置相关的子页面路径\\nconst AGENT_CONFIG_PATHS = [\\n  '/ai-roles',\\n  '/agent-workflow',\\n  '/ai-chat-multi',\\n  '/public-page-configs',\\n  '/ai-management',\\n];\\n\\n\\nconst TopNavigation: React.FC&amp;lt;TopNavigationProps&amp;gt; = ({ currentPageTitle }) =&amp;gt; {\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\n  const location = useLocation();\\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&amp;lt;PublicPageConfig[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\n  const [userMenuOpen, setUserMenuOpen] = useState(false);\\n  const [currentUsername, setCurrentUsername] = useState&amp;lt;string&amp;gt;('用户');\\n  \\n  // 获取当前登录用户名\\n  const getCurrentUsername = (): string =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // 尝试从 localStorage 获取用户名（支持多种可能的键名）\\n      const username = localStorage.getItem('username') || \\n                       localStorage.getItem('user_name') || \\n                       localStorage.getItem('currentUser') ||\\n                       localStorage.getItem('userName');\\n      if (username) {\\n        // 如果是 JSON 字符串，尝试解析\\n        try {\\n          const parsed = JSON.parse(username);\\n          return parsed.name || parsed.username || parsed.userName || username;\\n        } catch {\\n          return username;\\n        }\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.warn('获取用户名失败:', error);\\n    }\\n    // 默认返回\\\"用户\\\"\\n    return '用户';\\n  };\\n  \\n  // 初始化用户名\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\n    \\n    // 监听 localStorage 变化（跨标签页同步）\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (e.key === 'username' || e.key === 'user_name' || e.key === 'currentUser' || e.key === 'userName') {\\n        setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\n      }\\n    };\\n    \\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n    \\n    // 监听自定义事件（同标签页更新）\\n    const handleUserUpdate = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\n    };\\n    \\n    window.addEventListener('userUpdated', handleUserUpdate);\\n    \\n    return () =&amp;gt; {\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n      window.removeEventListener('userUpdated', handleUserUpdate);\\n    };\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      setLoading(true);\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\\n        (config) =&amp;gt; config.isActive &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.address\\n      );\\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\n        return;\\n      }\\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\\n    } finally {\\n      setLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 初始加载\\n    loadActiveConfigs();\\n\\n    // 监听配置更新事件\\n    const handleConfigUpdate = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n\\n    // 监听storage变化（跨标签页通信）\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\\n        loadActiveConfigs();\\n      }\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n    \\n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\\n    const handleCustomRefresh = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n\\n    return () =&amp;gt; {\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n    };\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    const items: NavigationItem[] = [];\\n\\n    // 按照固定顺序生成主要功能项\\n    MAIN_NAV_ORDER.forEach((navItem) =&amp;gt; {\\n      // 如果是项目管理，直接添加\\n      if (navItem.name === '项目管理') {\\n        items.push({\\n          id: 'home',\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n        return;\\n      }\\n\\n      // 其他功能：从配置中查找对应的配置\\n      const config = activeConfigs.find(\\n        (c) =&amp;gt; c.address === navItem.address || c.name === navItem.name\\n      );\\n\\n      if (config) {\\n        items.push({\\n          id: config.id,\\n          label: config.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: &amp;#96;/${config.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n          configId: config.id,\\n        });\\n      } else {\\n        // 如果配置不存在，仍然显示但禁用\\n        items.push({\\n          id: &amp;#96;placeholder-${navItem.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: true,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n      }\\n    });\\n\\n    return items;\\n  }, [activeConfigs]);\\n\\n  // 生成管理功能导航项\\n  const managementItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    return MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER.map((navItem) =&amp;gt; ({\\n      id: navItem.path,\\n      label: navItem.name,\\n      icon: navItem.icon,\\n      path: navItem.path,\\n      disabled: false,\\n      category: 'management' as const,\\n    }));\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  const handleNavigation = (path: string, disabled?: boolean, itemId?: string) =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (disabled) {\\n      return;\\n    }\\n    // 如果是项目管理（首页），添加 tab=all 参数\\n    if (path === '/' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; itemId === 'home') {\\n      navigate('/?tab=all');\\n    } else {\\n      navigate(path);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const isCurrentPath = (path: string) =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 首页特殊处理\\n    if (path === '/') {\\n      // 检查是否是首页路径（忽略查询参数）\\n      return location.pathname === '/' || location.pathname === '/tech-package';\\n    }\\n    // Agent配置特殊处理：如果当前路径是Agent配置的子页面，也认为是当前路径\\n    if (path === '/ai-management') {\\n      return AGENT_CONFIG_PATHS.some(agentPath =&amp;gt; \\n        location.pathname === agentPath || location.pathname.startsWith(agentPath + '/')\\n      );\\n    }\\n    // 精确匹配\\n    return location.pathname === path || location.pathname.startsWith(path + '/');\\n  };\\n\\n  // 渲染导航按钮组\\n  const renderNavGroup = (items: NavigationItem[], groupIndex: number) =&amp;gt; {\\n    return (\\n      &amp;lt;div key={groupIndex} className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        {items.map((item) =&amp;gt; {\\n          const Icon = item.icon;\\n          const isCurrent = isCurrentPath(item.path);\\n\\n          return (\\n            &amp;lt;React.Fragment key={item.id}&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; handleNavigation(item.path, item.disabled, item.id)}\\n                disabled={item.disabled}\\n                className={&amp;#96;\\n                  relative flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium\\n                  transition-all duration-200 group\\n                  ${\\n                    item.disabled\\n                      ? \\\"text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed opacity-50\\\"\\n                      : isCurrent\\n                        ? \\\"text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 shadow-sm\\\"\\n                        : \\\"text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50\\\"\\n                  }\\n                &amp;#96;}\\n                title={item.label}\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;Icon className={&amp;#96;w-4 h-4 ${isCurrent ? 'text-blue-600' : 'text-gray-500 group-hover:text-blue-600'}&amp;#96;} /&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;{item.label}&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n                \\n                {/* 当前页面指示器 */}\\n                {isCurrent &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (\\n                  &amp;lt;div className=\\\"absolute bottom-0 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 w-1 h-1 bg-blue-600 rounded-full\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n                )}\\n              &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/React.Fragment&amp;gt;\\n          );\\n        })}\\n      &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n    );\\n  };\\n\\n  return (\\n    &amp;lt;div className=\\\"bg-white border-b border-gray-200 sticky top-0 z-50 shadow-sm\\\"&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;div className=\\\"w-full px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center h-16 justify-between\\\"&amp;gt;\\n          {/* 左侧导航项 */}\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {/* 第一组：项目管理 */}\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              {renderNavGroup([mainItems[0]], 0)}\\n            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n            \\n            {/* 分隔符 */}\\n            &amp;lt;span className=\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\"&amp;gt;｜&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n\\n            {/* 第二组：技术包装、技术策略、技术通稿、发布会稿 */}\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              {renderNavGroup(mainItems.slice(1), 1)}\\n            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 右侧：加载状态和用户标识 */}\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center gap-4\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {/* 加载状态指示器 */}\\n            {loading &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (\\n              &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;div className=\\\"h-4 w-4 border-2 border-blue-600 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n            )}\\n\\n            {/* 用户标识和下拉菜单 */}\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"relative flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; setUserMenuOpen(!userMenuOpen)}\\n                className=\\\"flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50 transition-all duration-200\\\"\\n                title={currentUsername}\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;User className=\\\"w-4 h-4\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;{currentUsername}&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;ChevronDown className={&amp;#96;w-4 h-4 transition-transform duration-200 ${userMenuOpen ? 'transform rotate-180' : ''}&amp;#96;} /&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n\\n              {/* 下拉菜单 */}\\n              {userMenuOpen &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (\\n                &amp;lt;&amp;gt;\\n                  {/* 背景遮罩，点击关闭菜单 */}\\n                  &amp;lt;div\\n                    className=\\\"fixed inset-0 z-40\\\"\\n                    onClick={() =&amp;gt; setUserMenuOpen(false)}\\n                  /&amp;gt;\\n                  {/* 下拉菜单内容 */}\\n                  &amp;lt;div className=\\\"absolute right-0 top-full mt-2 w-48 bg-white rounded-lg shadow-lg border border-gray-200 py-1 z-50\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                    {managementItems.map((item) =&amp;gt; {\\n                      const Icon = item.icon;\\n                      const isCurrent = isCurrentPath(item.path);\\n                      \\n                      return (\\n                        &amp;lt;button\\n                          key={item.id}\\n                          onClick={() =&amp;gt; {\\n                            handleNavigation(item.path, item.disabled, item.id);\\n                            setUserMenuOpen(false);\\n                          }}\\n                          disabled={item.disabled}\\n                          className={&amp;#96;\\n                            w-full flex items-center space-x-2 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium\\n                            transition-colors duration-200\\n                            ${\\n                              item.disabled\\n                                ? \\\"text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed opacity-50\\\"\\n                                : isCurrent\\n                                  ? \\\"text-blue-600 bg-blue-50\\\"\\n                                  : \\\"text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50\\\"\\n                            }\\n                          &amp;#96;}\\n                        &amp;gt;\\n                          &amp;lt;Icon className=\\\"w-4 h-4\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n                          &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;{item.label}&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n                        &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n                      );\\n                    })}\\n                  &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;/&amp;gt;\\n              )}\\n            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n        &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n  );\\n};\\n\\nexport default TopNavigation;\\n\","

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"// AI问答页面配置（独立页面，复用tech-package系统但可定制化）\\nexport const aiQaConfig: PageConfig = {\\n  pageType: 'ai-qa',\\n  pageTitle: 'AI问答',\\n  dialogueTitle: 'AI问答助手',\\n  studioTitle: '更多工具箱',\\n  workflowSelectionKey: 'ai-search.workflows.selection.ai-qa',\\n  featureLabelMap: {\\n    \\\"five-view-analysis\\\": \\\"五看\\\",\\n    \\\"three-fix-analysis\\\": \\\"三定\\\",\\n    \\\"tech-matrix\\\": \\\"技术矩阵\\\",\\n    \\\"propagation-strategy\\\": \\\"传播\\\",\\n    \\\"exhibition-video\\\": \\\"展具与视频\\\",\\n    translation: \\\"翻译\\\",\\n    \\\"ppt-outline\\\": \\\"技术讲稿\\\",\\n    script: \\\"脚本\\\",\\n  },\\n  // AI问答页面保留所有工具，可根据需要定制\\n  enabledToolIds: [\\n    'five-view-analysis',\\n    'three-fix-analysis',\\n    'tech-matrix',\\n    'propagation-strategy',\\n    'exhibition-video',\\n    'translation',\\n    'ppt-outline',\\n    'script',\\n  ],\\n};\\n\\n// 根据页面类型获取配置\\nexport const getPageConfig = (pageType: PageType)\\n;\","
                },

                  "content": "            \"text\": \"// AI问答页面配置（独立页面，复用tech-package系统但可定制化）\","
