                {
                  "lineNumber": 4990,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"/**\\n * AI问答页面\\n * 复用tech-package系统构建，但作为独立页面可进行定制化改造\\n */\\nimport React from \\\"react\\\";\\nimport BaseAISearchPage from \\\"../components/ai-search/BaseAISearchPage\\\";\\nimport { aiQaConfig } from \\\"../configs/pageConfigs\\\";\\n\\nconst AIQAPage: React.FC = () =&amp;gt; {\\n  return &amp;lt;BaseAISearchPage config={aiQaConfig} /&amp;gt;;\\n};\\n\\nexport default AIQAPage;\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 5002,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \" * 复用tech-package系统构建，但作为独立页面可进行定制化改造\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 5230,
                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"  \\\"contents\\\": \\\"import api from './api';\\\\nimport { agentWorkflowService } from './agentWorkflowService';\\\\nimport { techPointService } from './techPointService';\\\\nimport { knowledgePointService } from './knowledgePointService';\\\\nimport {\\\\n  Conversation,\\\\n  Message,\\\\n  OutputContent,\\\\n  WorkflowConfig,\\\\n  FileUploadResponse,\\\\n  CreateConversationRequest,\\\\n  SendMessageRequest,\\\\n  ApiResponse,\\\\n  Source,\\\\n  FieldMappingConfig,\\\\n} from '../types/aiSearch';\\\\n\\\\n/**\\\\n * AI问答服务\\\\n */\\\\nclass AiSearchService {\\\\n  private normalizeMessage(raw: any): Message {\\\\n    return {\\\\n      ...raw,\\\\n      createdAt: raw?.createdAt ? new Date(raw.createdAt) : new Date(),\\\\n    };\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 获取配置的工作流\\\\n   */\\\\n  async getWorkflowConfig(pageType?: 'tech-package' | 'press-release' | 'tech-strategy' | 'tech-article'): Promise&amp;amp;lt;WorkflowConfig | null&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      // 先尝试从API获取配置的工作流ID，传递pageType参数\\\\n      const params = pageType ? &amp;amp;#96;?pageType=${pageType}&amp;amp;#96; : '';\\\\n      const response = await api.get(&amp;amp;#96;/ai-search/workflow${params}&amp;amp;#96;);\\\\n      if (response.data.success &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; response.data.data) {\\\\n        const workflowId = response.data.data.workflowId;\\\\n        // 获取工作流详情\\\\n        const workflows = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\\\\n        const workflow = workflows.find((w) =&amp;amp;gt; w.id === workflowId);\\\\n        if (workflow) {\\\\n          return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(workflow);\\\\n        }\\\\n      }\\\\n      \\\\n      // 如果没有配置，尝试查找默认工作流（根据页面类型）\\\\n      const workflows = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\\\\n      const defaultWorkflowName = pageType === 'press-release' ? '发布会稿工作流' : '智能工作流';\\\\n      const defaultWorkflow = workflows.find((w) =&amp;amp;gt; w.name === defaultWorkflowName);\\\\n      if (defaultWorkflow) {\\\\n        return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(defaultWorkflow);\\\\n      }\\\\n      \\\\n      // 返回第一个工作流\\\\n      if (workflows.length &amp;amp;gt; 0) {\\\\n        return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(workflows[0]);\\\\n      }\\\\n      \\\\n      return null;\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.error('获取工作流配置失败:', error);\\\\n      return null;\\\\n    }\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 转换工作流为配置格式\\\\n   */\\\\n  private convertWorkflowToConfig(workflow: any): WorkflowConfig {\\\\n    // 从工作流的输入节点和输出节点提取参数\\\\n    const inputNode = workflow.nodes.find((n: any) =&amp;amp;gt; n.type === 'input');\\\\n    const outputNode = workflow.nodes.find((n: any) =&amp;amp;gt; n.type === 'output');\\\\n    \\\\n    const inputParameters = inputNode?.data?.inputs || [];\\\\n    const outputParameters = outputNode?.data?.outputs || [];\\\\n    \\\\n    return {\\\\n      id: workflow.id,\\\\n      name: workflow.name,\\\\n      description: workflow.description,\\\\n      inputParameters: inputParameters.map((p: any) =&amp;amp;gt; ({\\\\n        name: p.name,\\\\n        type: p.type || 'string',\\\\n        required: p.required || false,\\\\n        description: p.description,\\\\n      })),\\\\n      outputParameters: outputParameters.map((p: any) =&amp;amp;gt; ({\\\\n        name: p.name,\\\\n        type: p.type || 'object',\\\\n        description: p.description,\\\\n      })),\\\\n    };\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 获取文件列表\\\\n   */\\\\n  async getFiles(options?: {\\\\n    category?: string;\\\",\""
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 5234,
                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"  \\\"contents\\\": \\\"/**\\\\n * AI问答页面\\\\n * 复用tech-package系统构建，但作为独立页面可进行定制化改造\\\\n */\\\\nimport React from \\\\\\\"react\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport BaseAISearchPage from \\\\\\\"../components/ai-search/BaseAISearchPage\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport { aiQaConfig } from \\\\\\\"../configs/pageConfigs\\\\\\\";\\\\n\\\\nconst AIQAPage: React.FC = () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  return &amp;amp;lt;BaseAISearchPage config={aiQaConfig} /&amp;amp;gt;;\\\\n};\\\\n\\\\nexport default AIQAPage;\\\\n\\\\n\\\",\""
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 5251,
                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"  \\\"contents\\\": \\\"import { apiClient, type ApiErrorPayload, type ApiResponse } from \\\\\\\"@/shared/lib/api/apiClient\\\\\\\";\\\\n\\\\nexport interface WorkflowResponse {\\\\n  success: boolean;\\\\n  data?: any;\\\\n  error?: string;\\\\n  message?: string;\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\nconst toWorkflowResponse = &amp;amp;lt;T&amp;amp;gt;(response: ApiResponse&amp;amp;lt;T&amp;amp;gt; &amp;amp;amp; { message?: string }): WorkflowResponse =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  if (response.success) {\\\\n    return {\\\\n      success: true,\\\\n      data: response.data,\\\\n      message: response.message,\\\\n    };\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  return {\\\\n    success: false,\\\\n    error: response.error?.message ?? response.message ?? \\\\\\\"请求失败\\\\\\\",\\\\n    data: response.data,\\\\n  };\\\\n};\\\\n\\\\nconst handleApiError = (scope: string, error: unknown): WorkflowResponse =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  console.error(&amp;amp;#96;${scope} error:&amp;amp;#96;, error);\\\\n  if ((error as ApiErrorPayload)?.message) {\\\\n    return {\\\\n      success: false,\\\\n      error: (error as ApiErrorPayload).message,\\\\n    };\\\\n  }\\\\n  if (error instanceof Error) {\\\\n    return {\\\\n      success: false,\\\\n      error: error.message,\\\\n    };\\\\n  }\\\\n  return {\\\\n    success: false,\\\\n    error: \\\\\\\"请求失败\\\\\\\",\\\\n  };\\\\n};\\\\n\\\\nexport interface DifyAPIConfig {\\\\n  id: string;\\\\n  name: string;\\\\n  description: string;\\\\n  apiUrl: string;\\\\n  apiKey: string;\\\\n  enabled: boolean;\\\\n  createdAt?: Date;\\\\n  updatedAt?: Date;\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\nconst warnDeprecatedDifyConfig = (scope: string) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  console.warn(&amp;amp;#96;[workflowAPI] 已忽略前端传入的 difyConfig (${scope})，所有调用均改为通过后端网关处理&amp;amp;#96;);\\\\n};\\\\n\\\\nexport const workflowAPI = {\\\\n  // AI问答 - 支持自定义Dify配置\\\\n  aiSearch: async (query: string, inputs: any = {}, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;amp;gt; =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('aiSearch');\\\\n\\\\n    try {\\\\n      const response = await apiClient.post&amp;amp;lt;{ message?: string }&amp;amp;gt;(\\\\\\\"/workflow/ai-search\\\\\\\", {\\\\n        query,\\\\n        inputs,\\\\n        conversationId,\\\\n      }, {\\\\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\\\\n      });\\\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      return handleApiError(\\\\\\\"AI search API\\\\\\\", error);\\\\n    }\\\\n  },\\\\n\\\\n  // 智能搜索\\\\n  smartSearch: async (query: string, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;amp;gt; =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('smartSearch');\\\\n\\\\n    try {\\\\n      const requestData: any = { query };\\\\n      if (conversationId) {\\\\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\\\\\\\"/workflow/smart-search\\\\\\\", requestData, {\\\\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\\\\n      });\\\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      return handleApiError(\\\\\\\"Smart search API\\\\\\\", error);\\\\n    }\\\\n  },\\\\n\\\\n  // 技术包装\\\\n  techPackage: async (searchResults: any, template?: string, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;amp;gt; =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('techPackage');\\\\n\\\\n    try {\\\\n      let inputs: any;\\\\n\\\\n      if (searchResults &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; typeof searchResults === 'object' &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; searchResults.query) {\\\\n        inputs = {\\\\n          query: searchResults.query,\\\\n          selectedKnowledgePoints: searchResults.selectedKnowledgePoints,\\\\n        };\\\\n      } else {\\\\n        inputs = {\\\\n          searchResults: searchResults,\\\\n          template: template,\\\\n        };\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      const requestData: any = { inputs };\\\\n      if (conversationId) {\\\\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\\\\\\\"/workflow/tech-package\\\\\\\", requestData, {\\\\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\\\\n      });\\\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      return handleApiError(\\\\\\\"Tech package API\\\\\\\", error);\\\\n    }\\\\n  },\\\\n\\\\n  // 技术策略\\\\n  techStrategy: async (techPackage: any, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;amp;gt; =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('techStrategy');\\\\n\\\\n    try {\\\\n      const requestData: any = {\\\\n        inputs: { techPackage },\\\\n      };\\\\n      if (conversationId) {\\\\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\\\\\\\"/workflow/tech-strategy\\\\\\\", requestData, {\\\\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\\\\n      });\\\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      return handleApiError(\\\\\\\"Tech strategy API\\\\\\\", error);\\\\n    }\\\\n  },\\\\n\\\\n  // 推广策略\\\\n  promotionStrategy: async (techStrategy: any, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;amp;gt; =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('promotionStrategy');\\\\n\\\\n    try {\\\\n      const requestData: any = {\\\\n        inputs: { techStrategy },\\\\n      };\\\\n      if (conversationId) {\\\\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\\\\\\\"/workflow/promotion-strategy\\\\\\\", requestData, {\\\\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\\\\n      });\\\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      return handleApiError(\\\\\\\"Promotion strategy API\\\\\\\", error);\\\\n    }\\\\n  },\\\\n\\\\n  // 技术通稿\\\\n  coreDraft: async (promotionStrategy: any, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;amp;gt; =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('coreDraft');\\\\n\\\\n    try {\\\\n      const requestData: any = {\\\\n        inputs: { promotionStrategy },\\\\n      };\\\\n      if (conversationId) {\\\\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\\\\\\\"/workflow/core-draft\\\\\\\", requestData, {\\\\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\\\\n      });\\\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      return handleApiError(\\\\\\\"Core draft API\\\\\\\", error);\\\\n    }\\\\n  },\\\\n\\\\n  // 发布会演讲稿\\\\n  speechGeneration: async (coreDraft: any, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;amp;gt; =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('speechGeneration');\\\\n\\\\n    try {\\\\n      const requestData: any = {\\\\n        inputs: { coreDraft },\\\\n      };\\\\n      if (conversationId) {\\\\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\\\\\\\"/workflow/speech-generation\\\\\\\", requestData, {\\\\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\\\\n      });\\\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      return handleApiError(\\\\\\\"Speech generation API\\\\\\\", error);\\\\n    }\\\\n  },\\\\n\\\\n  // 演讲稿\\\\n  speech: async (inputs: any, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;amp;gt; =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('speech');\\\\n\\\\n    try {\\\\n      const requestData: any = { inputs };\\\\n      if (conversationId) {\\\\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\\\\\\\"/workflow/speech-generation\\\\\\\", requestData);\\\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      return handleApiError(\\\\\\\"Speech API\\\\\\\", error);\\\\n    }\\\\n  },\\\\n};\\\\n\\\\nconst legacyApi = {\\\\n  async get&amp;amp;lt;T = unknown&amp;amp;gt;(url: string, config?: any) {\\\\n    const data = await apiClient.get&amp;amp;lt;T&amp;amp;gt;(url, config);\\\\n    return { data };\\\\n  },\\\\n  async post&amp;amp;lt;T = unknown&amp;amp;gt;(url: string, body?: any, config?: any) {\\\\n    const data = await apiClient.post&amp;amp;lt;T&amp;amp;gt;(url, body, config);\\\\n    return { data };\\\\n  },\\\\n  async put&amp;amp;lt;T = unknown&amp;amp;gt;(url: string, body?: any, config?: any) {\\\\n    const data = await apiClient.put&amp;amp;lt;T&amp;amp;gt;(url, body, config);\\\\n    return { data };\\\\n  },\\\\n  async delete&amp;amp;lt;T = unknown&amp;amp;gt;(url: string, config?: any) {\\\\n    const data = await apiClient.delete&amp;amp;lt;T&amp;amp;gt;(url, config);\\\\n    return { data };\\\\n  },\\\\n};\\\\n\\\\nexport default legacyApi;\\\\n\\\",\""
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 5260,
                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"  \\\"contents\\\": \\\"import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from \\\\\\\"react\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport { useNavigate, useLocation } from \\\\\\\"react-router-dom\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport {\\\\n  MessageCircle,\\\\n  Target,\\\\n  FileText,\\\\n  Mic,\\\\n  Home,\\\\n  Bot,\\\\n  Workflow,\\\\n  MessageSquare,\\\\n  Layers,\\\\n} from \\\\\\\"lucide-react\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport publicPageConfigService from \\\\\\\"../services/publicPageConfigService\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport { PublicPageConfig } from \\\\\\\"../types/publicPageConfig\\\\\\\";\\\\n\\\\ninterface TopNavigationProps {\\\\n  currentPageTitle?: string;\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\ninterface NavigationItem {\\\\n  id: string;\\\\n  label: string;\\\\n  icon: any;\\\\n  path: string;\\\\n  disabled: boolean;\\\\n  category: 'main' | 'management';\\\\n  configId?: string;\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n// 主要功能的固定顺序和映射\\\\nconst MAIN_NAV_ORDER = [\\\\n  { name: 'AI问答', icon: Home, path: '/', address: null },\\\\n  { name: '技术包装', icon: MessageCircle, path: '/tech-package', address: 'tech-package' },\\\\n  { name: '技术策略', icon: Target, path: '/tech-strategy', address: 'tech-strategy' },\\\\n  { name: '技术通稿', icon: FileText, path: '/tech-article', address: 'tech-article' },\\\\n  { name: '发布会稿', icon: Mic, path: '/press-release', address: 'press-release' },\\\\n];\\\\n\\\\n// 管理功能的固定顺序和映射\\\\nconst MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER = [\\\\n  { name: 'AI角色', icon: Bot, path: '/ai-roles' },\\\\n  { name: 'Agent工作流', icon: Workflow, path: '/agent-workflow' },\\\\n  { name: '多角色对话', icon: MessageSquare, path: '/ai-chat-multi' },\\\\n  { name: '页面配置', icon: Layers, path: '/public-page-configs' },\\\\n];\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nconst TopNavigation: React.FC&amp;amp;lt;TopNavigationProps&amp;amp;gt; = ({ currentPageTitle }) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\\\n  const location = useLocation();\\\\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&amp;amp;lt;PublicPageConfig[]&amp;amp;gt;([]);\\\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\\\n\\\\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\\\\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      setLoading(true);\\\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\\\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\\\\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\\\\n        (config) =&amp;amp;gt; config.isActive &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; config.address\\\\n      );\\\\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\\\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\\\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\\\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\\\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\\\n        return;\\\\n      }\\\\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\\\\n    } finally {\\\\n      setLoading(false);\\\\n    }\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 初始加载\\\\n    loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n\\\\n    // 监听配置更新事件\\\\n    const handleConfigUpdate = () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\\\n\\\\n    // 监听storage变化（跨标签页通信）\\\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\\\\n        loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n      }\\\\n    };\\\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n    \\\\n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\\\\n    const handleCustomRefresh = () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n    };\\\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\\\n\\\\n    return () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\\\n    };\\\\n  }, []);\\\\n\\\\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\\\\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const items: NavigationItem[] = [];\\\\n\\\\n    // 按照固定顺序生成主要功能项\\\\n    MAIN_NAV_ORDER.forEach((navItem) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      // 如果是AI问答，直接添加\\\\n      if (navItem.name === 'AI问答') {\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: 'home',\\\\n          label: navItem.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: navItem.path,\\\\n          disabled: false,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n        });\\\\n        return;\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      // 其他功能：从配置中查找对应的配置\\\\n      const config = activeConfigs.find(\\\\n        (c) =&amp;amp;gt; c.address === navItem.address || c.name === navItem.name\\\\n      );\\\\n\\\\n      if (config) {\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: config.id,\\\\n          label: config.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: &amp;amp;#96;/${config.address}&amp;amp;#96;,\\\\n          disabled: false,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n          configId: config.id,\\\\n        });\\\\n      } else {\\\\n        // 如果配置不存在，仍然显示但禁用\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: &amp;amp;#96;placeholder-${navItem.address}&amp;amp;#96;,\\\\n          label: navItem.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: navItem.path,\\\\n          disabled: true,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n        });\\\\n      }\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n    return items;\\\\n  }, [activeConfigs]);\\\\n\\\\n  // 生成管理功能导航项\\\\n  const managementItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    return MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER.map((navItem) =&amp;amp;gt; ({\\\\n      id: navItem.path,\\\\n      label: navItem.name,\\\\n      icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n      path: navItem.path,\\\\n      disabled: false,\\\\n      category: 'management' as const,\\\\n    }));\\\\n  }, []);\\\\n\\\\n  const handleNavigation = (path: string, disabled?: boolean) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (disabled) {\\\\n      return;\\\\n    }\\\\n    navigate(path);\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  const isCurrentPath = (path: string) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 首页特殊处理\\\\n    if (path === '/') {\\\\n      return location.pathname === '/' || location.pathname === '/tech-package';\\\\n    }\\\\n    // 精确匹配\\\\n    return location.pathname === path || location.pathname.startsWith(path + '/');\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  // 渲染导航按钮组\\\\n  const renderNavGroup = (items: NavigationItem[], groupIndex: number) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    return (\\\\n      &amp;amp;lt;div key={groupIndex} className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n        {items.map((item) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n          const Icon = item.icon;\\\\n          const isCurrent = isCurrentPath(item.path);\\\\n\\\\n          return (\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;React.Fragment key={item.id}&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;button\\\\n                onClick={() =&amp;amp;gt;                   "content": "  \"contents\": \"import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from \\\"react\\\";\\nimport { useNavigate, useLocation } from \\\"react-router-dom\\\";\\nimport {\\n  MessageCircle,\\n  Target,\\n  FileText,\\n  Mic,\\n  Home,\\n  Bot,\\n  Workflow,\\n  MessageSquare,\\n  Layers,\\n} from \\\"lucide-react\\\";\\nimport publicPageConfigService from \\\"../services/publicPageConfigService\\\";\\nimport { PublicPageConfig } from \\\"../types/publicPageConfig\\\";\\n\\ninterface TopNavigationProps {\\n  currentPageTitle?: string;\\n}\\n\\ninterface NavigationItem {\\n  id: string;\\n  label: string;\\n  icon: any;\\n  path: string;\\n  disabled: boolean;\\n  category: 'main' | 'management';\\n  configId?: string;\\n}\\n\\n// 主要功能的固定顺序和映射\\nconst MAIN_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: 'AI问答', icon: Home, path: '/', address: null },\\n  { name: '技术包装', icon: MessageCircle, path: '/tech-package', address: 'tech-package' },\\n  { name: '技术策略', icon: Target, path: '/tech-strategy', address: 'tech-strategy' },\\n  { name: '技术通稿', icon: FileText, path: '/tech-article', address: 'tech-article' },\\n  { name: '发布会稿', icon: Mic, path: '/press-release', address: 'press-release' },\\n];\\n\\n// 管理功能的固定顺序和映射\\nconst MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: 'AI角色', icon: Bot, path: '/ai-roles' },\\n  { name: 'Agent工作流', icon: Workflow, path: '/agent-workflow' },\\n  { name: '多角色对话', icon: MessageSquare, path: '/ai-chat-multi' },\\n  { name: '页面配置', icon: Layers, path: '/public-page-configs' },\\n];\\n\\n\\nconst TopNavigation: React.FC&amp;lt;TopNavigationProps&amp;gt; = ({ currentPageTitle }) =&amp;gt; {\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\n  const location = useLocation();\\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&amp;lt;PublicPageConfig[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\n\\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      setLoading(true);\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\\n        (config) =&amp;gt; config.isActive &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.address\\n      );\\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\n        return;\\n      }\\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\\n    } finally {\\n      setLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 初始加载\\n    loadActiveConfigs();\\n\\n    // 监听配置更新事件\\n    const handleConfigUpdate = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n\\n    // 监听storage变化（跨标签页通信）\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\\n        loadActiveConfigs();\\n      }\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n    \\n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\\n    const handleCustomRefresh = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n\\n    return () =&amp;gt; {\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n    };\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    const items: NavigationItem[] = [];\\n\\n    // 按照固定顺序生成主要功能项\\n    MAIN_NAV_ORDER.forEach((navItem) =&amp;gt; {\\n      // 如果是AI问答，直接添加\\n      if (navItem.name === 'AI问答') {\\n        items.push({\\n          id: 'home',\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n        return;\\n      }\\n\\n      // 其他功能：从配置中查找对应的配置\\n      const config = activeConfigs.find(\\n        (c) =&amp;gt; c.address === navItem.address || c.name === navItem.name\\n      );\\n\\n      if (config) {\\n        items.push({\\n          id: config.id,\\n          label: config.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: &amp;#96;/${config.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n          configId: config.id,\\n        });\\n      } else {\\n        // 如果配置不存在，仍然显示但禁用\\n        items.push({\\n          id: &amp;#96;placeholder-${navItem.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: true,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n      }\\n    });\\n\\n    return items;\\n  }, [activeConfigs]);\\n\\n  // 生成管理功能导航项\\n  const managementItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    return MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER.map((navItem) =&amp;gt; ({\\n      id: navItem.path,\\n      label: navItem.name,\\n      icon: navItem.icon,\\n      path: navItem.path,\\n      disabled: false,\\n      category: 'management' as const,\\n    }));\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  const handleNavigation = (path: string, disabled?: boolean) =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (disabled) {\\n      return;\\n    }\\n    navigate(path);\\n  };\\n\\n  const isCurrentPath = (path: string) =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 首页特殊处理\\n    if (path === '/') {\\n      return location.pathname === '/' || location.pathname === '/tech-package';\\n    }\\n    // 精确匹配\\n    return location.pathname === path || location.pathname.startsWith(path + '/');\\n  };\\n\\n  // 渲染导航按钮组\\n  const renderNavGroup = (items: NavigationItem[], groupIndex: number) =&amp;gt; {\\n    return (\\n      &amp;lt;div key={groupIndex} className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        {items.map((item) =&amp;gt; {\\n          const Icon = item.icon;\\n          const isCurrent = isCurrentPath(item.path);\\n\\n          return (\\n            &amp;lt;React.Fragment key={item.id}&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; handleNavigation(item.path, item.disabled)}\\n                disabled={item.disabled}\\n                className={&amp;#96;\\n                  relative flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium\\n                  transition-all duration-200 group\\n                  ${\\n                    item.disabled\\n                      ? \\\"text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed opacity-50\\\"\\n                      : isCurrent\\n                        ? \\\"text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 shadow-sm\\\"\\n                        : \\\"text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50\\\"\\n                  }\\n                &amp;#96;}\\n                title={item.label}\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;Icon className={&amp;#96;w-4 h-4 ${isCurrent ? 'text-blue-600' : 'text-gray-500 group-hover:text-blue-600'}&amp;#96;} /&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;{item.label}&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n                \\n                {/* 当前页面指示器 */}\\n                {isCurrent &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (\\n                  &amp;lt;div className=\\\"absolute bottom-0 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 w-1 h-1 bg-blue-600 rounded-full\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n                )}\\n              &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/React.Fragment&amp;gt;\\n          );\\n        })}\\n      &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n    );\\n  };\\n\\n  return (\\n    &amp;lt;div className=\\\"bg-white border-b border-gray-200 sticky top-0 z-50 shadow-sm\\\"&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;div className=\\\"max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center h-16\\\"&amp;gt;\\n          {/* 第一组：AI问答 */}\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {renderNavGroup([mainItems[0]], 0)}\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n          \\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\n          &amp;lt;span className=\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\"&amp;gt;｜&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 第二组：技术包装、技术策略、技术通稿、发布会稿 */}\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {renderNavGroup(mainItems.slice(1), 1)}\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\n          &amp;lt;span className=\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\"&amp;gt;｜&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 第三组：AI角色、Agent工作流、多角色对话、页面配置 */}\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {renderNavGroup(managementItems, 2)}\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\n          {currentPageTitle &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (\\n            &amp;lt;&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;span className=\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\"&amp;gt;｜&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n              {/* 当前页面标题 */}\\n              &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;h1 className=\\\"text-base font-semibold text-gray-900\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                  {currentPageTitle}\\n                &amp;lt;/h1&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/&amp;gt;\\n          )}\\n\\n          {/* 加载状态指示器 */}\\n          {loading &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"ml-4 flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;div className=\\\"h-4 w-4 border-2 border-blue-600 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n          )}\\n        &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n  );\\n};\\n\\nexport default TopNavigation;\\n\","

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"const RESERVED_ROUTES = [\\n 'field-mapping-management'\\n];\\n\\n/**\\n * 根据地址（address）加载公开页面配置并渲染对应模版的页面\\n * 路由：/ai-search, /tech-package 等\\n */\\nconst AddressPage: React.FC = () =&amp;gt; {\\n  const { address } = useParams&amp;lt;{ address: string }&amp;gt;();\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\\n  const [executionResult, setExecutionResult] = useState&amp;lt;any&amp;gt;(null);\\n  const [publicConfig, setPublicConfig] = useState&amp;lt;PublicPageConfigPreview | null&amp;gt;(null);\\n  const [configLoading, setConfigLoading] = useState(true);\\n  const [error, setError] = useState&amp;lt;string | null&amp;gt;(null);\\n\\n  // 加载公开页面配置\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    const loadPublicConfig = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (!address) {\\n        setError('地址参数缺失');\\n        setConfigLoading(false);\\n        return;\\n      }\\n\\n      // 检查是否是保留路由\\n      if (RESERVED_ROUTES.includes(address)) {\\n        setError('该路径为系统保留路径');\\n        setConfigLoading(false);\\n        return;\\n      }\\n\\n      try {\\n        setConfigLoading(true);\\n        setError(null);\\n        // 根据地址查找配置\\n        const configData = await publicPageConfigService.getPublicConfigByAddress(address);\\n        if (configData &amp;amp;&amp;amp; configData.config) {\\n          setPublicConfig(configData);\\n        } else {\\n          setError('未找到对应的页面配置');\\n        }\\n      } catch (err: any) {\\n        console.error('加载配置失败:', err);\\n        // 如果404，说明不是有效的地址配置，跳转到首页\\n        if (err.response?.status === 404) {\\n          navigate('/');\\n          return;\\n        }\\n        setError(err.message || '加载配置失败');\\n      } finally {\\n        setConfigLoading(false);\\n      }\\n    };\\n\\n    loadPublicConfig();\\n  }, [address, navigate]);\\n\\n  // 处理节点执行\\n  const handleNodeExecution = async (inputData: any)\\n;\\n;\","

                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from \\\"react\\\";\\nimport { useNavigate, useLocation } from \\\"react-router-dom\\\";\\nimport {\\n  MessageCircle,\\n  Target,\\n  FileText,\\n  Mic,\\n  Home,\\n  Bot,\\n  Workflow,\\n  MessageSquare,\\n  Layers,\\n} from \\\"lucide-react\\\";\\nimport publicPageConfigService from \\\"../services/publicPageConfigService\\\";\\nimport { PublicPageConfig } from \\\"../types/publicPageConfig\\\";\\n\\ninterface TopNavigationProps {\\n  currentPageTitle?: string;\\n}\\n\\ninterface NavigationItem {\\n  id: string;\\n  label: string;\\n  icon: any;\\n  path: string;\\n  disabled: boolean;\\n  category: 'main' | 'management';\\n  configId?: string;\\n}\\n\\n// 主要功能的固定顺序和映射\\nconst MAIN_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: 'AI问答', icon: Home, path: '/', address: null },\\n  { name: '技术包装', icon: MessageCircle, path: '/tech-package', address: 'tech-package' },\\n  { name: '技术策略', icon: Target, path: '/tech-strategy', address: 'tech-strategy' },\\n  { name: '技术通稿', icon: FileText, path: '/tech-article', address: 'tech-article' },\\n  { name: '发布会稿', icon: Mic, path: '/press-release', address: 'press-release' },\\n];\\n\\n// 管理功能的固定顺序和映射\\nconst MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: 'AI角色', icon: Bot, path: '/ai-roles' },\\n  { name: 'Agent工作流', icon: Workflow, path: '/agent-workflow' },\\n  { name: '多角色对话', icon: MessageSquare, path: '/ai-chat-multi' },\\n  { name: '页面配置', icon: Layers, path: '/public-page-configs' },\\n];\\n\\n\\nconst TopNavigation: React.FC&amp;lt;TopNavigationProps&amp;gt; = ({ currentPageTitle }) =&amp;gt; {\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\n  const location = useLocation();\\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&amp;lt;PublicPageConfig[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\n\\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      setLoading(true);\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\\n        (config) =&amp;gt; config.isActive &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.address\\n      );\\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\n        return;\\n      }\\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\\n    } finally {\\n      setLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 初始加载\\n    loadActiveConfigs();\\n\\n    // 监听配置更新事件\\n    const handleConfigUpdate = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n\\n    // 监听storage变化（跨标签页通信）\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\\n        loadActiveConfigs();\\n      }\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n    \\n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\\n    const handleCustomRefresh = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n\\n    return () =&amp;gt; {\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n    };\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    const items: NavigationItem[] = [];\\n\\n    // 按照固定顺序生成主要功能项\\n    MAIN_NAV_ORDER.forEach((navItem) =&amp;gt; {\\n      // 如果是AI问答，直接添加\\n      if (navItem.name === 'AI问答') {\\n        items.push({\\n          id: 'home',\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n        return;\\n      }\\n\\n      // 其他功能：从配置中查找对应的配置\\n      const config = activeConfigs.find(\\n        (c) =&amp;gt; c.address === navItem.address || c.name === navItem.name\\n      );\\n\\n      if (config) {\\n        items.push({\\n          id: config.id,\\n          label: config.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: &amp;#96;/${config.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n          configId: config.id,\\n        });\\n      } else {\\n        // 如果配置不存在，仍然显示但禁用\\n        items.push({\\n          id: &amp;#96;placeholder-${navItem.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: true,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n      }\\n    });\\n\\n    return items;\\n  }, [activeConfigs]);\\n\\n  // 生成管理功能导航项\\n  const managementItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    return MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER.map((navItem) =&amp;gt; ({\\n      id: navItem.path,\\n      label: navItem.name,\\n      icon: navItem.icon,\\n      path: navItem.path,\\n      disabled: false,\\n      category: 'management' as const,\\n    }));\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  const handleNavigation = (path: string, disabled?: boolean) =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (disabled) {\\n      return;\\n    }\\n    navigate(path);\\n  };\\n\\n  const isCurrentPath = (path: string) =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 首页特殊处理\\n    if (path === '/') {\\n      return location.pathname === '/' || location.pathname === '/tech-package';\\n    }\\n    // 精确匹配\\n    return location.pathname === path || location.pathname.startsWith(path + '/');\\n  };\\n\\n  // 渲染导航按钮组\\n  const renderNavGroup = (items: NavigationItem[], groupIndex: number) =&amp;gt; {\\n    return (\\n      &amp;lt;div key={groupIndex} className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        {items.map((item) =&amp;gt; {\\n          const Icon = item.icon;\\n          const isCurrent = isCurrentPath(item.path);\\n\\n          return (\\n            &amp;lt;React.Fragment key={item.id}&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; handleNavigation(item.path, item.disabled)}\\n                disabled={item.disabled}\\n                className={&amp;#96;\\n                  relative flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium\\n                  transition-all duration-200 group\\n                  ${\\n                    item.disabled\\n                      ? \\\"text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed opacity-50\\\"\\n                      : isCurrent\\n                        ? \\\"text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 shadow-sm\\\"\\n                        : \\\"text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50\\\"\\n                  }\\n                &amp;#96;}\\n                title={item.label}\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;Icon className={&amp;#96;w-4 h-4 ${isCurrent ? 'text-blue-600' : 'text-gray-500 group-hover:text-blue-600'}&amp;#96;} /&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;{item.label}&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n                \\n                {/* 当前页面指示器 */}\\n                {isCurrent &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (\\n                  &amp;lt;div className=\\\"absolute bottom-0 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 w-1 h-1 bg-blue-600 rounded-full\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n                )}\\n              &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/React.Fragment&amp;gt;\\n          );\\n        })}\\n      &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n    );\\n  };\\n\\n  return (\\n    &amp;lt;div className=\\\"bg-white border-b border-gray-200 sticky top-0 z-50 shadow-sm\\\"&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;div className=\\\"max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center h-16\\\"&amp;gt;\\n          {/* 第一组：AI问答 */}\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {renderNavGroup([mainItems[0]], 0)}\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n          \\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\n          &amp;lt;span className=\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\"&amp;gt;｜&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 第二组：技术包装、技术策略、技术通稿、发布会稿 */}\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {renderNavGroup(mainItems.slice(1), 1)}\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\n          &amp;lt;span className=\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\"&amp;gt;｜&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 第三组：AI角色、Agent工作流、多角色对话、页面配置 */}\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {renderNavGroup(managementItems, 2)}\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\n          {currentPageTitle &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (\\n            &amp;lt;&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;span className=\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\"&amp;gt;｜&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n              {/* 当前页面标题 */}\\n              &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;h1 className=\\\"text-base font-semibold text-gray-900\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                  {currentPageTitle}\\n                &amp;lt;/h1&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/&amp;gt;\\n          )}\\n\\n          {/* 加载状态指示器 */}\\n          {loading &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"ml-4 flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;div className=\\\"h-4 w-4 border-2 border-blue-600 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n          )}\\n        &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n  );\\n};\\n\\nexport default TopNavigation;\\n\","

                  "lineNumber": 16358,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"// 主要功能的固定顺序和映射\\nconst MAIN_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: '项目管理', icon: Home, path: '/', address: null },\\n  { name: '技术包装', icon: MessageCircle, path: '/tech-package', address: 'tech-package' },\\n  { name: '技术策略', icon: Target, path: '/tech-strategy', address: 'tech-strategy' },\\n  { name: '技术通稿', icon: FileText, path: '/tech-article', address: 'tech-article' },\\n  { name: '发布会稿', icon: Mic, path: '/press-release', address: 'press-release' },\\n];\\n\\n// 管理功能的固定顺序和映射\\nconst MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: 'AI角色', icon: Bot, path: '/ai-roles' },\\n  { name: 'Agent工作流', icon: Workflow, path: '/agent-workflow' },\\n  { name: '多角色对话', icon: MessageSquare, path: '/ai-chat-multi' },\\n  { name: '页面配置', icon: Layers, path: '/public-page-configs' },\\n];\\n\\n\\nconst TopNavigation: React.FC&amp;lt;TopNavigationProps&amp;gt; = ({ currentPageTitle }) =&amp;gt;\\n;\","

                  "lineNumber": 16454,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"const FieldMappingConfigManager: React.FC = \\n\\n\\n  const loadData = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      setLoading(true);\\n      const [mappingsData, workflowsData, rolesData] = await Promise.all([\\n        aiSearchService.getAllFieldMappingConfigs(),\\n        agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows(),\\n        aiRoleService.getAIRoles(),\\n      ]);\\n      const rows: FieldMappingListItem[] = [];\\n      for (const mapping of mappingsData) {\\n        const featureObjects = Array.isArray(mapping.config.featureObjects)\\n          ? mapping.config.featureObjects\\n          : [];\\n        if (featureObjects.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n          for (const feature of featureObjects) {\\n            // 排除AI对话框\\n            if (feature.featureType === 'ai-dialog') {\\n              continue;\\n            }\\n            const workflowId = feature.workflowId || mapping.workflowId;\\n            const workflow = workflowsData.find((w) =&amp;gt; w.id === workflowId);\\n            rows.push({\\n              ...mapping,\\n              workflowId,\\n              workflowName: workflow?.name || '未知工作流',\\n              pageName: feature.pageType ? (PAGE_LABELS[feature.pageType as keyof typeof PAGE_LABELS] || PAGE_LABELS['tech-package']) : (FEATURE_PAGE_MAP[feature.featureType] || '技术包装'),\\n              featureType: feature.featureType,\\n              featureLabel: (feature as any).label || FEATURE_LABELS[feature.featureType] || feature.featureType,\\n              config: {\\n                ...mapping.config,\\n                inputMappings: feature.inputMappings || [],\\n                outputMappings: feature.outputMappings || [],\\n              },\\n            });\\n          }\\n        }\\n      }\\n      setMappings(rows);\\n      setWorkflows(workflowsData);\\n      setRoles(rolesData);\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('加载数据失败:', error);\\n      setMessage({ type: 'error', text: '加载数据失败，请稍后重试' });\\n    } finally {\\n      setLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleEdit = (mapping: FieldMappingListItem) =&amp;gt;\\n;\\n;\","

                {
                  "lineNumber": 18461,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"-- 公开页面配置表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public_page_configs (\\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\\n    description TEXT,\\n    address TEXT,                              -- 地址配置\\n    display_mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'all',  -- all/workflow/custom/role\\n    workflow_id TEXT,                          -- 关联的工作流ID（workflow模式）\\n    role_ids TEXT,                             -- JSON字符串，角色ID列表（custom/role模式）\\n    access_token TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,         -- 访问令牌，用于生成访问链接\\n    is_active INTEGER DEFAULT 1,               -- 0或1，是否启用\\n    template_type TEXT,                        -- 模板类型: 'speech', 'ai-chat', 'custom'\\n    custom_html TEXT,                          -- 自定义HTML内容\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\n);\\n\\n-- 页面工具配置表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS page_tool_configs (\\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\\n    page_type TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,  -- 页面类型: 'tech-package', 'press-release', 'tech-strategy', 'tech-article'\\n    page_title TEXT NOT NULL,         -- 页面标题\\n    dialogue_title TEXT NOT NULL,     -- 对话标题\\n    studio_title TEXT NOT NULL,       -- Studio侧边栏标题\\n    workflow_selection_key TEXT NOT NULL,  -- 工作流选择键\\n    enabled_tool_ids TEXT,            -- JSON数组，启用的工具ID列表\\n    feature_label_map TEXT,           -- JSON对象，功能标签映射\\n    is_active INTEGER DEFAULT 1,     -- 0或1，是否启用\\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\n);\\n\\n-- 文件存储表\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS files (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\","

                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from \\\"react\\\";\\nimport { useNavigate, useLocation } from \\\"react-router-dom\\\";\\nimport {\\n  MessageCircle,\\n  Target,\\n  FileText,\\n  Mic,\\n  Home,\\n  Bot,\\n  Workflow,\\n  MessageSquare,\\n  Layers,\\n} from \\\"lucide-react\\\";\\nimport publicPageConfigService from \\\"../services/publicPageConfigService\\\";\\nimport { PublicPageConfig } from \\\"../types/publicPageConfig\\\";\\n\\ninterface TopNavigationProps {\\n  currentPageTitle?: string;\\n}\\n\\ninterface NavigationItem {\\n  id: string;\\n  label: string;\\n  icon: any;\\n  path: string;\\n  disabled: boolean;\\n  category: 'main' | 'management';\\n  configId?: string;\\n}\\n\\n// 主要功能的固定顺序和映射\\nconst MAIN_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: '项目管理', icon: Home, path: '/', address: null },\\n  { name: '技术包装', icon: MessageCircle, path: '/tech-package', address: 'tech-package' },\\n  { name: '技术策略', icon: Target, path: '/tech-strategy', address: 'tech-strategy' },\\n  { name: '技术通稿', icon: FileText, path: '/tech-article', address: 'tech-article' },\\n  { name: '发布会稿', icon: Mic, path: '/press-release', address: 'press-release' },\\n];\\n\\n// 管理功能的固定顺序和映射\\nconst MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: 'AI角色', icon: Bot, path: '/ai-roles' },\\n  { name: 'Agent工作流', icon: Workflow, path: '/agent-workflow' },\\n  { name: '多角色对话', icon: MessageSquare, path: '/ai-chat-multi' },\\n  { name: '页面配置', icon: Layers, path: '/public-page-configs' },\\n];\\n\\n\\nconst TopNavigation: React.FC&amp;lt;TopNavigationProps&amp;gt; = ({ currentPageTitle }) =&amp;gt; {\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\n  const location = useLocation();\\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&amp;lt;PublicPageConfig[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\n\\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      setLoading(true);\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\\n        (config) =&amp;gt; config.isActive &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.address\\n      );\\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\n        return;\\n      }\\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\\n    } finally {\\n      setLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 初始加载\\n    loadActiveConfigs();\\n\\n    // 监听配置更新事件\\n    const handleConfigUpdate = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n\\n    // 监听storage变化（跨标签页通信）\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\\n        loadActiveConfigs();\\n      }\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n    \\n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\\n    const handleCustomRefresh = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n\\n    return () =&amp;gt; {\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n    };\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    const items: NavigationItem[] = [];\\n\\n    // 按照固定顺序生成主要功能项\\n    MAIN_NAV_ORDER.forEach((navItem) =&amp;gt; {\\n      // 如果是项目管理，直接添加\\n      if (navItem.name === '项目管理') {\\n        items.push({\\n          id: 'home',\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n        return;\\n      }\\n\\n      // 其他功能：从配置中查找对应的配置\\n      const config = activeConfigs.find(\\n        (c) =&amp;gt; c.address === navItem.address || c.name === navItem.name\\n      );\\n\\n      if (config) {\\n        items.push({\\n          id: config.id,\\n          label: config.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: &amp;#96;/${config.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n          configId: config.id,\\n        });\\n      } else {\\n        // 如果配置不存在，仍然显示但禁用\\n        items.push({\\n          id: &amp;#96;placeholder-${navItem.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: true,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n      }\\n    });\\n\\n    return items;\\n  }, [activeConfigs]);\\n\\n  // 生成管理功能导航项\\n  const managementItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    return MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER.map((navItem) =&amp;gt; ({\\n      id: navItem.path,\\n      label: navItem.name,\\n      icon: navItem.icon,\\n      path: navItem.path,\\n      disabled: false,\\n      category: 'management' as const,\\n    }));\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  const handleNavigation = (path: string, disabled?: boolean, itemId?: string) =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (disabled) {\\n      return;\\n    }\\n    // 如果是项目管理（首页），添加 tab=all 参数\\n    if (path === '/' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; itemId === 'home') {\\n      navigate('/?tab=all');\\n    } else {\\n      navigate(path);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const isCurrentPath = (path: string) =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 首页特殊处理\\n    if (path === '/') {\\n      // 检查是否是首页路径（忽略查询参数）\\n      return location.pathname === '/' || location.pathname === '/tech-package';\\n    }\\n    // 精确匹配\\n    return location.pathname === path || location.pathname.startsWith(path + '/');\\n  };\\n\\n  // 渲染导航按钮组\\n  const renderNavGroup = (items: NavigationItem[], groupIndex: number) =&amp;gt; {\\n    return (\\n      &amp;lt;div key={groupIndex} className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        {items.map((item) =&amp;gt; {\\n          const Icon = item.icon;\\n          const isCurrent = isCurrentPath(item.path);\\n\\n          return (\\n            &amp;lt;React.Fragment key={item.id}&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      setLoading(true);\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\\n        (config) =&amp;gt; config.isActive &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.address\\n      );\\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\n        return;\\n      }\\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\\n    } finally {\\n      setLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\\n        loadActiveConfigs();\\n      }\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n    \\n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\\n    const handleCustomRefresh = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n\\n    return () =&amp;gt; {\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n    };\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt;                   "content": "  \"contents\": \"import { db } from '@/config/database';\\nimport { logger } from '@/shared/lib/logger';\\nimport crypto from 'crypto';\\nimport fs from 'fs';\\nimport path from 'path';\\n\\nexport interface FileRecord {\\n  id: number;\\n  file_id: string;\\n  original_name: string;\\n  stored_name: string;\\n  file_path: string;\\n  file_url: string;\\n  mime_type: string;\\n  file_size: number;\\n  file_hash?: string;\\n  category: string;\\n  tags?: string;\\n  description?: string;\\n  uploader_id?: string;\\n  conversation_id?: string;\\n  usage_count: number;\\n  last_used_at?: string;\\n  status: 'active' | 'archived' | 'deleted';\\n  metadata?: string;\\n  created_at: string;\\n  updated_at: string;\\n}\\n\\nexport interface CreateFileParams {\\n  original_name: string;\\n  stored_name: string;\\n  file_path: string;\\n  file_url: string;\\n  mime_type: string;\\n  file_size: number;\\n  file_hash?: string;\\n  category?: string;\\n  tags?: string[];\\n  description?: string;\\n  uploader_id?: string;\\n  conversation_id?: string;\\n  metadata?: any;\\n}\\n\\nexport class FileService {\\n  /**\\n   * 初始化文件表\\n   */\\n  async initializeTable(): Promise&amp;lt;void&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const sql = &amp;#96;\\n        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS files (\\n          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n          file_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,\\n          original_name TEXT NOT NULL,\\n          stored_name TEXT NOT NULL,\\n          file_path TEXT NOT NULL,\\n          file_url TEXT NOT NULL,\\n          mime_type TEXT NOT NULL,\\n          file_size INTEGER NOT NULL,\\n          file_hash TEXT,\\n          category TEXT DEFAULT 'general',\\n          tags TEXT,\\n          description TEXT,\\n          uploader_id TEXT,\\n          conversation_id TEXT,\\n          usage_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\\n          last_used_at DATETIME,\\n          status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\\n          metadata TEXT,\\n          created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n          updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\n        );\\n\\n        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_file_id ON files(file_id);\\n        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_category ON files(category);\\n        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_status ON files(status);\\n        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_conversation_id ON files(conversation_id);\\n        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_created_at ON files(created_at);\\n        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_file_hash ON files(file_hash);\\n      &amp;#96;;\\n\\n      // 执行多个SQL语句\\n      const statements = sql.split(';').filter(s =&amp;gt; s.trim());\\n      for (const statement of statements) {\\n        if (statement.trim()) {\\n          await db.query(statement);\\n        }\\n      }\\n      logger.info('文件表初始化成功');\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.error('文件表初始化失败:', error);\\n      throw error;\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 计算文件哈希值\\n   */\\n  private async calculateFileHash(filePath: string): Promise&amp;lt;string&amp;gt; {\\n    return new Promise((resolve, reject) =&amp;gt; {\\n      const hash = crypto.createHash('sha256');\\n      const stream = fs.createReadStream(filePath);\\n\\n      stream.on('data', (data) =&amp;gt; hash.update(data));\\n      stream.on('end', () =&amp;gt; resolve(hash.digest('hex')));\\n      stream.on('error', reject);\\n    });\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 生成文件ID\\n   */\\n  private generateFileId(): string {\\n    return &amp;#96;file_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 15)}&amp;#96;;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 创建文件记录\\n   */\\n  async createFile(params: CreateFileParams): Promise&amp;lt;FileRecord&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // 计算文件哈希值\\n      let fileHash: string | undefined;\\n      if (fs.existsSync(params.file_path)) {\\n        fileHash = await this.calculateFileHash(params.file_path);\\n        \\n        // 检查是否已存在相同哈希的文件\\n        const existing = await this.findByHash(fileHash);\\n        if (existing) {\\n          // 如果文件已存在，增加使用次数并返回现有记录\\n          await this.incrementUsageCount(existing.file_id);\\n          return existing;\\n        }\\n      }\\n\\n      const fileId = this.generateFileId();\\n      const tagsJson = params.tags ? JSON.stringify(params.tags) : null;\\n      const metadataJson = params.metadata ? JSON.stringify(params.metadata) : null;\\n\\n      const sql = &amp;#96;\\n        INSERT INTO files (\\n          file_id, original_name, stored_name, file_path, file_url,\\n          mime_type, file_size, file_hash, category, tags, description,\\n          uploader_id, conversation_id, metadata\\n        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\\n      &amp;#96;;\\n\\n      await db.query(sql, [\\n        fileId,\\n        params.original_name,\\n        params.stored_name,\\n        params.file_path,\\n        params.file_url,\\n        params.mime_type,\\n        params.file_size,\\n        fileHash || null,\\n        params.category || 'general',\\n        tagsJson,\\n        params.description || null,\\n        params.uploader_id || null,\\n        params.conversation_id || null,\\n        metadataJson,\\n      ]);\\n\\n      const file = await this.getFileByFileId(fileId);\\n      if (!file) {\\n        throw new Error('创建文件记录失败');\\n      }\\n\\n      logger.info('文件记录创建成功', { fileId, originalName: params.original_name });\\n      return file;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.error('创建文件记录失败:', error);\\n      throw error;\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 根据文件ID获取文件记录\\n   */\\n  async getFileByFileId(fileId: string): Promise&amp;lt;FileRecord | null&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const sql = &amp;#96;SELECT * FROM files WHERE file_id = ? AND status = 'active'&amp;#96;;\\n      const rows = await db.query(sql, [fileId]);\\n      return rows.length &amp;gt; 0 ? (rows[0] as FileRecord) : null;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.error('获取文件记录失败:', error);\\n      return null;\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 根据哈希值查找文件\\n   */\\n  async findByHash(fileHash: string): Promise&amp;lt;FileRecord | null&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const sql = &amp;#96;SELECT * FROM files WHERE file_hash = ? AND status = 'active' LIMIT 1&amp;#96;;\\n      const rows = await db.query(sql, [fileHash]);\\n      return rows.length &amp;gt; 0 ? (rows[0] as FileRecord) : null;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.error('根据哈希查找文件失败:', error);\\n      return null;\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 增加文件使用次数\\n   */\\n  async incrementUsageCount(fileId: string): Promise&amp;lt;void&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const sql = &amp;#96;\\n        UPDATE files \\n        SET usage_count = usage_count + 1,\\n            last_used_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n            updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\n        WHERE file_id = ?\\n      &amp;#96;;\\n      await db.query(sql, [fileId]);\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.error('增加文件使用次数失败:', error);\\n      throw error;\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取所有文件列表\\n   */\\n  async getAllFiles(options?: {\\n    category?: string;\\n    status?: string;\\n    conversationId?: string;\\n    pageType?: string; // 页面类型：'tech-package' | 'press-release'\\n    limit?: number;\\n    offset?: number;\\n    excludeGarbled?: boolean; // 排除乱码文件名\\n  }): Promise&amp;lt;FileRecord[]&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      let sql = &amp;#96;SELECT * FROM files WHERE 1=1&amp;#96;;\\n      const params: any[] = [];\\n\\n      if (options?.category) {\\n        sql += &amp;#96; AND category = ?&amp;#96;;\\n        params.push(options.category);\\n      }\\n\\n      if (options?.status) {\\n        sql += &amp;#96; AND status = ?&amp;#96;;\\n        params.push(options.status);\\n      } else {\\n        sql += &amp;#96; AND status = 'active'&amp;#96;;\\n      }\\n\\n      if (options?.conversationId) {\\n        sql += &amp;#96; AND conversation_id = ?&amp;#96;;\\n        params.push(options.conversationId);\\n      }\\n\\n      // 按页面类型过滤（通过metadata字段）\\n      if (options?.pageType) {\\n        // 只返回metadata中包含指定pageType的文件\\n        sql += &amp;#96; AND metadata LIKE ?&amp;#96;;\\n        params.push(&amp;#96;%\\\"pageType\\\":\\\"${options.pageType}\\\"%&amp;#96;);\\n      }\\n      // 如果没有指定pageType，返回所有文件（包括没有metadata的旧文件）\\n\\n      // 排除乱码文件名\\n      if (options?.excludeGarbled) {\\n        sql += &amp;#96; AND original_name NOT LIKE '%ã€%' AND original_name NOT LIKE '%ç¥%' AND original_name NOT LIKE '%æ%'&amp;#96;;\\n      }\\n\\n      sql += &amp;#96; ORDER BY created_at DESC&amp;#96;;\\n\\n      if (options?.limit) {\\n        sql += &amp;#96; LIMIT ?&amp;#96;;\\n        params.push(options.limit);\\n      }\\n\\n      if (options?.offset) {\\n        sql += &amp;#96; OFFSET ?&amp;#96;;\\n        params.push(options.offset);\\n      }\\n\\n      const rows = await db.query(sql, params);\\n      \\n      // 基于文件哈希去重，只保留最新的记录\\n      const fileMap = new Map&amp;lt;string, FileRecord&amp;gt;();\\n      for (const row of rows as FileRecord[]) {\\n        if (row.file_hash) {\\n          const existing = fileMap.get(row.file_hash);\\n          if (!existing || new Date(row.created_at) &amp;gt; new Date(existing.created_at)) {\\n            fileMap.set(row.file_hash, row);\\n          }\\n        } else {\\n          // 没有哈希值的文件，使用file_id作为key\\n          fileMap.set(row.file_id, row);\\n        }\\n      }\\n      \\n      return Array.from(fileMap.values());\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.error('获取文件列表失败:', error);\\n      return [];\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 更新文件信息\\n   */\\n  async updateFile(fileId: string, updates: {\\n    description?: string;\\n    tags?: string[];\\n    category?: string;\\n    metadata?: any;\\n  }): Promise&amp;lt;FileRecord | null&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const setClauses: string[] = [];\\n      const params: any[] = [];\\n\\n      if (updates.description !== undefined) {\\n        setClauses.push('description = ?');\\n        params.push(updates.description);\\n      }\\n\\n      if (updates.tags !== undefined) {\\n        setClauses.push('tags = ?');\\n        params.push(JSON.stringify(updates.tags));\\n      }\\n\\n      if (updates.category !== undefined) {\\n        setClauses.push('category = ?');\\n        params.push(updates.category);\\n      }\\n\\n      if (updates.metadata !== undefined) {\\n        setClauses.push('metadata = ?');\\n        params.push(JSON.stringify(updates.metadata));\\n      }\\n\\n      if (setClauses.length === 0) {\\n        return await this.getFileByFileId(fileId);\\n      }\\n\\n      setClauses.push('updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP');\\n      params.push(fileId);\\n\\n      const sql = &amp;#96;UPDATE files SET ${setClauses.join(', ')} WHERE file_id = ?&amp;#96;;\\n      await db.query(sql, params);\\n\\n      return await this.getFileByFileId(fileId);\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.error('更新文件信息失败:', error);\\n      return null;\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 删除文件（软删除）\\n   */\\n  async deleteFile(fileId: string): Promise&amp;lt;boolean&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const sql = &amp;#96;UPDATE files SET status = 'deleted', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE file_id = ?&amp;#96;;\\n      await db.query(sql, [fileId]);\\n      return true;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.error('删除文件失败:', error);\\n      return false;\\n    }\\n  }\\n}\\n\\nexport const fileService = new FileService();\\n\\n\","

                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import { apiClient, type ApiErrorPayload, type ApiResponse } from \\\"@/shared/lib/api/apiClient\\\";\\n\\nexport interface WorkflowResponse {\\n  success: boolean;\\n  data?: any;\\n  error?: string;\\n  message?: string;\\n}\\n\\nconst toWorkflowResponse = &amp;lt;T&amp;gt;(response: ApiResponse&amp;lt;T&amp;gt; &amp;amp; { message?: string }): WorkflowResponse =&amp;gt; {\\n  if (response.success) {\\n    return {\\n      success: true,\\n      data: response.data,\\n      message: response.message,\\n    };\\n  }\\n\\n  return {\\n    success: false,\\n    error: response.error?.message ?? response.message ?? \\\"请求失败\\\",\\n    data: response.data,\\n  };\\n};\\n\\nconst handleApiError = (scope: string, error: unknown): WorkflowResponse =&amp;gt; {\\n  console.error(&amp;#96;${scope} error:&amp;#96;, error);\\n  if ((error as ApiErrorPayload)?.message) {\\n    return {\\n      success: false,\\n      error: (error as ApiErrorPayload).message,\\n    };\\n  }\\n  if (error instanceof Error) {\\n    return {\\n      success: false,\\n      error: error.message,\\n    };\\n  }\\n  return {\\n    success: false,\\n    error: \\\"请求失败\\\",\\n  };\\n};\\n\\nexport interface DifyAPIConfig {\\n  id: string;\\n  name: string;\\n  description: string;\\n  apiUrl: string;\\n  apiKey: string;\\n  enabled: boolean;\\n  createdAt?: Date;\\n  updatedAt?: Date;\\n}\\n\\nconst warnDeprecatedDifyConfig = (scope: string) =&amp;gt; {\\n  console.warn(&amp;#96;[workflowAPI] 已忽略前端传入的 difyConfig (${scope})，所有调用均改为通过后端网关处理&amp;#96;);\\n};\\n\\nexport const workflowAPI = {\\n  // AI问答 - 支持自定义Dify配置\\n  aiSearch: async (query: string, inputs: any = {}, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;gt; =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('aiSearch');\\n\\n    try {\\n      const response = await apiClient.post&amp;lt;{ message?: string }&amp;gt;(\\\"/workflow/ai-search\\\", {\\n        query,\\n        inputs,\\n        conversationId,\\n      }, {\\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\\n      });\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      return handleApiError(\\\"AI search API\\\", error);\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  // 智能搜索\\n  smartSearch: async (query: string, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;gt; =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('smartSearch');\\n\\n    try {\\n      const requestData: any = { query };\\n      if (conversationId) {\\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\\n      }\\n\\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\\\"/workflow/smart-search\\\", requestData, {\\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\\n      });\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      return handleApiError(\\\"Smart search API\\\", error);\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  // 技术包装\\n  techPackage: async (searchResults: any, template?: string, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;gt; =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('techPackage');\\n\\n    try {\\n      let inputs: any;\\n\\n      if (searchResults &amp;amp;&amp;amp; typeof searchResults === 'object' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; searchResults.query) {\\n        inputs = {\\n          query: searchResults.query,\\n          selectedKnowledgePoints: searchResults.selectedKnowledgePoints,\\n        };\\n      } else {\\n        inputs = {\\n          searchResults: searchResults,\\n          template: template,\\n        };\\n      }\\n\\n      const requestData: any = { inputs };\\n      if (conversationId) {\\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\\n      }\\n\\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\\\"/workflow/tech-package\\\", requestData, {\\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\\n      });\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      return handleApiError(\\\"Tech package API\\\", error);\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  // 技术策略\\n  techStrategy: async (techPackage: any, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;gt;                   "content": "  \"contents\": \"import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from \\\"react\\\";\\nimport { useNavigate, useLocation } from \\\"react-router-dom\\\";\\nimport {\\n  MessageCircle,\\n  Target,\\n  FileText,\\n  Mic,\\n  Home,\\n  Bot,\\n  Workflow,\\n  MessageSquare,\\n  Layers,\\n} from \\\"lucide-react\\\";\\nimport publicPageConfigService from \\\"../services/publicPageConfigService\\\";\\nimport { PublicPageConfig } from \\\"../types/publicPageConfig\\\";\\n\\ninterface TopNavigationProps {\\n  currentPageTitle?: string;\\n}\\n\\ninterface NavigationItem {\\n  id: string;\\n  label: string;\\n  icon: any;\\n  path: string;\\n  disabled: boolean;\\n  category: 'main' | 'management';\\n  configId?: string;\\n}\\n\\n// 主要功能的固定顺序和映射\\nconst MAIN_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: 'AI问答', icon: Home, path: '/', address: null },\\n  { name: '技术包装', icon: MessageCircle, path: '/tech-package', address: 'tech-package' },\\n  { name: '技术策略', icon: Target, path: '/tech-strategy', address: 'tech-strategy' },\\n  { name: '技术通稿', icon: FileText, path: '/tech-article', address: 'tech-article' },\\n  { name: '发布会稿', icon: Mic, path: '/press-release', address: 'press-release' },\\n];\\n\\n// 管理功能的固定顺序和映射\\nconst MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: 'AI角色', icon: Bot, path: '/ai-roles' },\\n  { name: 'Agent工作流', icon: Workflow, path: '/agent-workflow' },\\n  { name: '多角色对话', icon: MessageSquare, path: '/ai-chat-multi' },\\n  { name: '页面配置', icon: Layers, path: '/public-page-configs' },\\n];\\n\\n\\nconst TopNavigation: React.FC&amp;lt;TopNavigationProps&amp;gt; = ({ currentPageTitle }) =&amp;gt; {\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\n  const location = useLocation();\\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&amp;lt;PublicPageConfig[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\n\\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      setLoading(true);\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\\n        (config) =&amp;gt; config.isActive &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.address\\n      );\\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\n        return;\\n      }\\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\\n    } finally {\\n      setLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 初始加载\\n    loadActiveConfigs();\\n\\n    // 监听配置更新事件\\n    const handleConfigUpdate = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n\\n    // 监听storage变化（跨标签页通信）\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\\n        loadActiveConfigs();\\n      }\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n    \\n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\\n    const handleCustomRefresh = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n\\n    return () =&amp;gt; {\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n    };\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    const items: NavigationItem[] = [];\\n\\n    // 按照固定顺序生成主要功能项\\n    MAIN_NAV_ORDER.forEach((navItem) =&amp;gt; {\\n      // 如果是AI问答，直接添加\\n      if (navItem.name === 'AI问答') {\\n        items.push({\\n          id: 'home',\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n        return;\\n      }\\n\\n      // 其他功能：从配置中查找对应的配置\\n      const config = activeConfigs.find(\\n        (c) =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (disabled) {\\n      return;\\n    }\\n    navigate(path);\\n  };\\n\\n  const isCurrentPath = (path: string) =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 首页特殊处理\\n    if (path === '/') {\\n      return location.pathname === '/' || location.pathname === '/tech-package';\\n    }\\n    // 精确匹配\\n    return location.pathname === path || location.pathname.startsWith(path + '/');\\n  };\\n\\n  // 渲染导航按钮组\\n  const renderNavGroup = (items: NavigationItem[], groupIndex: number) =&amp;gt; {\\n    return (\\n      &amp;lt;div key={groupIndex} className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        {items.map((item) =&amp;gt; {\\n          const Icon = item.icon;\\n          const isCurrent = isCurrentPath(item.path);\\n\\n          return (\\n            &amp;lt;React.Fragment key={item.id}&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; handleNavigation(item.path, item.disabled)}\\n                disabled={item.disabled}\\n                className={&amp;#96;\\n                  relative flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium\\n                  transition-all duration-200 group\\n                  ${\\n                    item.disabled\\n                      ? \\\"text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed opacity-50\\\"\\n                      : isCurrent\\n                        ? \\\"text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 shadow-sm\\\"\\n                        : \\\"text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50\\\"\\n                  }\\n                &amp;#96;}\\n                title={item.label}\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;Icon className={&amp;#96;w-4 h-4 ${isCurrent ?                   "content": "  \"contents\": \"-- 来源信息表\\n-- 用于存储通过 SourceSidebar 添加的信息（包括文本来源和外部来源）\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS source_information (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    source_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COMMENT '来源唯一标识（前端生成的ID）',\\n    title TEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '来源标题',\\n    type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('knowledge_base', 'external')) COMMENT '来源类型：knowledge_base=知识库，external=外部来源',\\n    url TEXT COMMENT '外部来源URL（仅external类型）',\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '来源描述/内容',\\n    page_type TEXT COMMENT '页面类型：tech-package, press-release, tech-strategy, tech-article',\\n    conversation_id TEXT COMMENT '关联的对话ID',\\n    metadata TEXT COMMENT '元数据（JSON格式）',\\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')) COMMENT '状态',\\n    created_by TEXT COMMENT '创建人',\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\\n);\\n\\n-- 创建索引\\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_source_id ON source_information(source_id);\\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_type ON source_information(type);\\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_page_type ON source_information(page_type);\\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_conversation_id ON source_information(conversation_id);\\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_status ON source_information(status);\\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_created_at ON source_information(created_at);\\n\\n\","
